term_master_catalog.name: term_master_catalog
term_master_catalog.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`, atp.`TERM_CODE`) AS `TERM_CODE`,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, atp.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
  COALESCE(at.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`, ata.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`, atp.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`) AS `IS_CURRENT_TERM`
FROM `academic_terms` at
RIGHT JOIN (
  -- gather all distinct TERM_CODEs across the three sources
  SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms`
  UNION
  SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms_all`
  UNION
  SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_term_parameter`
) all_terms ON all_terms.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN `academic_terms_all` ata ON ata.`TERM_CODE` = all_terms.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN `academic_term_parameter` atp ON atp.`TERM_CODE` = all_terms.`TERM_CODE`
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`, atp.`TERM_CODE`),
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, atp.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`),
  COALESCE(at.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`, ata.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`, atp.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`)
term_master_catalog.description: Canonical term lookup: prefer academic_terms, then academic_terms_all, then academic_term_parameter. Produces one row per TERM_CODE with TERM_DESCRIPTION and IS_CURRENT_TERM where available (coalesced in that preference order).

building_core_metrics.name: building_core_metrics
building_core_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
  b.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  COALESCE(f.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`) AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(f.`BUILDING_NAME`),''), NULLIF(TRIM(b.`BUILDING_NAME`),'')) AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  -- prefer fac_building's EXT_GROSS_AREA; fall back to buildings.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  CASE
    WHEN f.`EXT_GROSS_AREA` IS NOT NULL THEN f.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`
    WHEN b.`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` IS NOT NULL THEN b.`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `EXT_GROSS_AREA`,
  -- prefer fac_building's ASSIGNABLE_AREA; fall back to buildings.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  CASE
    WHEN f.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA` IS NOT NULL THEN f.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`
    WHEN b.`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` IS NOT NULL THEN b.`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,
  -- building height preference: fac_building.BUILDING_HEIGHT then buildings.BUILDING_COUNTER (if numeric) else NULL
  CASE
    WHEN f.`BUILDING_HEIGHT` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(f.`BUILDING_HEIGHT`)<>'' THEN f.`BUILDING_HEIGHT`
    WHEN b.`BUILDING_COUNTER` IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(b.`BUILDING_COUNTER` AS CHAR)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `BUILDING_HEIGHT`,
  -- carry through COST_COLLECTOR_KEY from fac_building; if missing, leave NULL (do not invent)
  f.`COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY`,
  -- HR org unit id may exist on fac_building (FAC_BUILDING has no explicit HR column in DDL but fac_building includes COST_COLLECTOR_KEY and maybe HR ORG in other sources).
  -- join attempt to employee_directory via building number is unreliable; keep NULL unless column exists in fac_building
  NULL AS `HR_ORG_UNIT_ID`,
  -- choose the most recent warehouse_load_date between fac_building and buildings
  CASE
    WHEN f.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` IS NULL AND b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN f.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` IS NULL THEN b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
    WHEN b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` IS NULL THEN f.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
    WHEN f.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` >= b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` THEN f.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
    ELSE b.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  END AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM `fac_building` f
LEFT JOIN `buildings` b
  ON ( (f.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND f.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
       OR (f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND b.`BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND f.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = b.`BUILDING_KEY`)
     )
/* Grain: one row per FAC_BUILDING_KEY (fac_building is the driving table) */
building_core_metrics.description: One row per fac_building exposing canonical building identifiers and primary area/height fields, joined where available to fallback 'buildings' table measurements. Keeps raw numeric measures (assignable and gross) and organizational keys for later enrichment.

building_rooms_summary.name: building_rooms_summary
building_rooms_summary.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  COUNT(fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
  SUM(fr.`AREA`) AS `ROOM_TOTAL_SQFT`,
  -- provide average per-room where room rows exist; leave NULL if no rooms
  CASE WHEN COUNT(fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`) > 0 THEN AVG(fr.`AREA`) ELSE NULL END AS `ROOM_AVG_SQFT`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`
building_rooms_summary.description: Per-building aggregation of room-level square footage from space_detail / fac_rooms to compute sum and average room square footage. Exposes counts and sums so final query can choose AVG_SQFT = TOTAL_SQFT (building-level) or per-room average when available.

instructor_subject_type_history.name: instructor_subject_type_history
instructor_subject_type_history.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- carry through instructor identifiers
  DISTINCT
  s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  -- subject_type: prefer CLUSTER_TYPE (aka CLUSTER_TYPE from subject_offered), else HGN_CODE
  COALESCE(NULLIF(s.CLUSTER_TYPE, ''), NULLIF(s.HGN_CODE, '')) AS subject_type
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section s
-- filter out rows with no instructor identifier and no name and no subject type
WHERE
  -- require at least one of the instructor identifiers (MIT_ID or NAME)
  (s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> '')
  OR (s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> '')
  -- and require a subject_type resolved
  AND ( (s.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND s.CLUSTER_TYPE <> '') OR (s.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND s.HGN_CODE <> '') )
instructor_subject_type_history.description: For each instructor (RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME or RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) and subject-type (using CLUSTER_TYPE else HGN_CODE), one row per instructor-subject_type indicating that the instructor has taught that subject-type at least once across all terms. Useful to count distinct subject-types an instructor has ever taught.

floor_assignable_area.name: floor_assignable_area
floor_assignable_area.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- Prefer canonical floor key when available; otherwise synthesize from building + floor
  COALESCE(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '::FLR::', fr.`FLOOR`)) AS `FLOOR_KEY`,
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`,
  -- Keep raw assignable area measure from source (AREA is assignable area in fac_rooms_space_area)
  SUM(fr.`AREA`) AS `FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
-- Only include rows that have a building and floor; leave filtering of specific buildings/terms to queries that select from this view
WHERE
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.`FLOOR` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '::FLR::', fr.`FLOOR`)),
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`
floor_assignable_area.description: Assignable area at the floor level. One row per floor (use floor key when available; otherwise use building key + floor number). Exposes canonical keys to join to canonical rooms. Keeps raw ASSIGNABLE_AREA measure.

building_assignable_area.name: building_assignable_area
building_assignable_area.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`                                        AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- prefer fac_building BUILDING_NAME if available, else buildings.BUILDING_NAME
  COALESCE(NULLIF(b.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), NULLIF(bg.`BUILDING_NAME`, '')) AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  -- expose assignable area from fac_building.ASSIGNABLE_AREA (numeric). If null, fall back to buildings.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  COALESCE(b.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, CAST(bg.`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) AS `BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,
  -- carry building number for joins
  COALESCE(NULLIF(b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ''), NULLIF(bg.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, '')) AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`
FROM
  `fac_building` b
LEFT JOIN
  `buildings` bg
    ON bg.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = b.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
building_assignable_area.description: Building-level attributes including assignable area and building name. One row per building key. Exposes ASSIGNABLE_AREA and BUILDING_NAME for joins and percent calculations.

fac_room_core.name: fac_room_core
fac_room_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  frs.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frs.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  frs.`FLOOR_KEY`,
  frs.`FLOOR`,
  frs.`ROOM`,
  frs.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  frs.`DEPT_CODE`,
  frs.`AREA`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` frs
WHERE
  frs.`BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND frs.`FLOOR` IS NOT NULL
  -- AREA must be numeric and positive; filter out zero / negative / NULL.
  AND frs.`AREA` IS NOT NULL
  AND frs.`AREA` > 0
fac_room_core.description: One row per physical room with canonical room identifiers, building/floor keys, primary organization and numeric area. Filtered to rooms that have a building_key, floor (label) and a positive area because many room-level questions need only real rooms with area.

fac_floor_assignable.name: fac_floor_assignable
fac_floor_assignable.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`FLOOR_KEY`,
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`,
  -- Sum of assignable area of rooms on the floor. Lift room-level NULLs to 0.
  COALESCE(SUM(fr.`AREA`), 0) AS `ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,
  -- Preserve EXT_GROSS_AREA from fac_building if available via building join.
  fb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`
FROM
  -- source: room-level areas with floor key
  `fac_rooms_space_area` AS fr
LEFT JOIN
  -- building-level gross area (may be NULL if building not in fac_building)
  `fac_building` AS fb
  ON fr.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
GROUP BY
  fr.`FLOOR_KEY`,
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`,
  fb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`
fac_floor_assignable.description: One row per floor (building + floor_key) exposing the floor's assignable area and identifying building. Useful for computing floor-level denominators and joining to room rows.

fac_rooms_rowlevel.name: fac_rooms_rowlevel
fac_rooms_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY,
  fr.FLOOR,
  fr.ROOM,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fr.AREA
FROM fac_rooms_space_area AS fr
fac_rooms_rowlevel.description: One row per facility room record: exposes room identifiers, building linkage, floor, organization, and area to serve as the canonical room cohort for building-level aggregations.

fac_building_canonical.name: fac_building_canonical
fac_building_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`                                  AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, fb2.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)  AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(fb2.`BUILDING_NAME`), '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.`COST_CENTER_CODE`                                  AS COST_CENTER_CODE,
  fb.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`                               AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  fac_building fb
LEFT JOIN
  buildings fb2
  ON fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` = fb2.`BUILDING_NUMBER`
WHERE
  fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
fac_building_canonical.description: Canonical building identifiers and names. Prefer fac_building fields when present; exposes FAC_BUILDING_KEY/BUILDING_KEY and BUILDING_NAME and cost center to help join to organization metadata.

student_department_school_membership.name: student_department_school_membership
student_department_school_membership.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.MIT_ID AS student_key,
  COALESCE(s.FULL_NAME, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.FIRST_NAME, s.MIDDLE_NAME, s.LAST_NAME)) AS student_full_name,
  s.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email,
  ds.department_code AS department_code,
  ds.department_name AS department_name,
  ds.school_name AS school_name,
  -- total distinct students in the department (precomputed per department)
  dept_counts.total_students_in_department,
  -- total distinct students in the school (precomputed per school)
  school_counts.total_students_in_school
FROM
  -- base student directory: using employee_directory (student rows are represented by MIT_ID rows in directory tables)
  employee_directory s
  -- join to a departmental assignment source. Use fac_rooms_space_area if present for dept membership,
  -- otherwise fall back to department fields on the directory row.
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_KEY AS department_code,
      ORGANIZATION_NAME AS department_name,
      NULL AS school_name,
      DEPT_CODE
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    WHERE ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS department_code,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
      NULL AS school_name,
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS DEPT_CODE
    FROM employee_directory
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) ds ON (ds.department_code = s.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER OR ds.DEPT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)

  -- Precompute distinct student counts per department
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      dept_key AS department_code,
      COUNT(DISTINCT student_key) AS total_students_in_department
    FROM (
      -- derive student->dept pairs from employee_directory (MIT_ID) joining to fac_rooms_space_area dept mapping
      SELECT
        ed.MIT_ID AS student_key,
        COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) AS dept_key
      FROM employee_directory ed
      LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area fr
        ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER OR fr.DEPT_CODE = ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
      WHERE COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
    ) AS pairs
    GROUP BY dept_key
  ) dept_counts ON dept_counts.department_code = ds.department_code

  -- Precompute distinct student counts per school (school_name comes from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject's SCHOOL_NAME when available).
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      school_key AS school_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT student_key) AS total_students_in_school
    FROM (
      -- attempt to map department -> school using latest subject summary which contains department -> school mapping
      SELECT
        p.student_key,
        COALESCE(ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ds_inferred.school_name) AS school_key
      FROM (
        SELECT
          ed.MIT_ID AS student_key,
          COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) AS dept_key
        FROM employee_directory ed
        LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area fr
          ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER OR fr.DEPT_CODE = ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
        WHERE COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
      ) p
      LEFT JOIN (
        -- map dept -> school using subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject where DEPARTMENT_CODE matches
        SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
      ) ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.dept_key
      LEFT JOIN (
        -- fallback: infer school_name null (keeps rows for grouping)
        SELECT DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_KEY AS dept, NULL AS school_name FROM fac_rooms_space_area
      ) ds_inferred ON ds_inferred.dept = p.dept_key
    ) AS student_school_pairs
    GROUP BY school_key
  ) school_counts ON school_counts.school_name = ds.school_name
student_department_school_membership.description: Row-level student-to-department association (one row per student-department pair) and precomputed distinct-student counts per department and per school. Exposes counts so final queries can report department and school totals without re-aggregating the entire warehouse every time.

instructor_directory_contacts.name: instructor_directory_contacts
instructor_directory_contacts.body_sql:
SELECT
  ed.MIT_ID                           AS MIT_ID,
  COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME, ed.NAME_KNOWN_BY) AS FULL_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS                    AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  ed.KRB_NAME                         AS KRB_NAME
FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
WHERE ed.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ed.MIT_ID, FULL_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS, KRB_NAME
instructor_directory_contacts.description: Directory of people with MIT_ID and canonical email addresses and full name, combining primary instructor/person tables for lookup. Exposes MIT_ID, FULL_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS and KRB_NAME where available to enable joins from instructor MIT IDs or names.

fac_building_core.name: fac_building_core
fac_building_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key carried through as requested
  fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`                                   AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- canonical building number from fac_building
  fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`                                    AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  -- prefer longer/cleaner building name field from fac_building
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, ''), NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`, '')) 
                                                          AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  -- prefer HR/department name when present; fall back to COST_CENTER_CODE if nothing else
  COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.`COST_CENTER_CODE`, ''), NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`, ''), NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, '')) 
                                                          AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  -- keep raw numeric area fields as-is
  fb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`                                     AS `EXT_GROSS_AREA`,
  fb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`                                    AS `ASSIGNABLE_AREA`,
  -- parse/normalize DATE_BUILT text: trim and keep as-is (no year extraction)
  NULLIF(TRIM(fb.`DATE_BUILT`), '')                       AS `DATE_BUILT`
FROM
  `fac_building` fb
-- Only one row per FAC_BUILDING_KEY; fac_building is the canonical source.
-- No filters applied here so the view contains all buildings present in fac_building.
fac_building_core.description: One-row-per-building canonicalized building attributes and numeric area fields (keeps raw EXT_GROSS_AREA and ASSIGNABLE_AREA as-is, parses DATE_BUILT text but does not extract year). Prefer fac_building.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME when present.

summer_subjects_offered.name: summer_subjects_offered
summer_subjects_offered.body_sql:
SELECT
  sobs.`TERM_CODE`                                                              AS TERM_CODE,
  sobs.`SUBJECT_ID` || '_' || sobs.`SECTION_ID`                                 AS SUBJECT_KEY,
  sobs.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`                                            AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  sobs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`                                                       AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  sobs.`COURSE_NUMBER`                                                           AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  sobs.`SUBJECT_ID`                                                              AS SUBJECT_ID,
  sobs.`SUBJECT_TITLE`                                                           AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  sobs.`SECTION_ID`                                                              AS SECTION_ID,
  sobs.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`                                                AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  sobs.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`                                              AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  COALESCE(sobs.`MEET_PLACE`, fr.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`)                               AS MEET_PLACE,
  sobs.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`                                                         AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  sobs.`FORM_TYPE`                                                               AS FORM_TYPE,
  sobs.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`                                                     AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section sobs
LEFT JOIN
  fac_rooms_space_area fr
    ON sobs.`MEET_PLACE` = fr.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`
    OR sobs.`MEET_PLACE` = fr.`SPACE_ID`
WHERE
  sobs.`TERM_CODE` LIKE CONCAT('%','SU')
  AND sobs.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND sobs.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
summer_subjects_offered.description: One row per subject offered in a term that appears to be a summer term (term codes ending with 'SU'); exposes subject and offering-level fields needed to join to faculty, building/room, and department data.

term_master.name: term_master
term_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`) AS `TERM_CODE`,
  -- prefer description from academic_terms, fall back to academic_terms_all
  COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, '')) AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
  -- normalize dates: prefer academic_terms, else academic_terms_all; keep as varchar per source
  COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_START_DATE`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`TERM_START_DATE`, '')) AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_END_DATE`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`TERM_END_DATE`, '')) AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, '')) AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
FROM `academic_terms` AS at
-- include all academic_terms_all rows not present in academic_terms to ensure one row per term code
RIGHT JOIN `academic_terms_all` AS ata
  ON at.`TERM_CODE` = ata.`TERM_CODE`
-- Ensure one row per TERM_CODE: use GROUP BY to collapse duplicates if both tables have multiple rows for same TERM_CODE.
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`)
term_master.description: Canonical academic term rows with TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION and key term dates — one row per term code. Normalizes available term description from academic_terms and academic_terms_all into a single canonical description and exposes TERM_CODE for joins.

building_floor_room_areas.name: building_floor_room_areas
building_floor_room_areas.body_sql:
SELECT
  bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  MIN(floors.FLOOR) AS `SMALLEST_FLOOR_LEVEL`,
  MAX(floors.FLOOR) AS `LARGEST_FLOOR_LEVEL`,
  SUM(COALESCE(rooms.AREA, 0)) AS `TOTAL_ROOMS_AREA`
FROM
  (
    -- gather distinct building keys from both fac_rooms_space_area and fac_building (and fac variants may be absent)
    SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY FROM fac_building
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY FROM buildings
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY FROM fclt_building_current
  ) AS bldg_keys
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area AS rooms
  ON rooms.BUILDING_KEY = bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- floors: floor values come from fac_rooms_space_area.FLOOR where present
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR FROM fac_rooms_space_area WHERE FLOOR IS NOT NULL
) AS floors
  ON floors.BUILDING_KEY = bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
  bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY
building_floor_room_areas.description: Aggregates floor level range and room area sums per building. Produces min and max FLOOR values from floor tables and SUM of room AREA per BUILDING_KEY (treating NULL areas as 0). Does not coalesce between fac_/fclt_ variants; includes rows even when floors or rooms missing (NULL aggregates).

cip_master.name: cip_master
cip_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.`PROGRAM_CODE`                                AS "PROGRAM_CODE (cip.PROGRAM_CODE)",
  c.`PROGRAM_TITLE`                               AS "PROGRAM_TITLE (cip.PROGRAM_TITLE)",
  c.`CATEGORY_CODE`                                AS "CATEGORY_CODE (cip.CATEGORY_CODE)",
  c.`CATEGORY_TITLE`                               AS "CATEGORY_TITLE (cip.CATEGORY_TITLE)",
  c.`FOUR_DIGIT_CODE`                              AS "FOUR_DIGIT_CODE (cip.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE)",
  c.`FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE`                             AS "FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE (cip.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE)",
  c.`VERSION`                                      AS "VERSION (cip.VERSION)"
FROM `cip` c
-- Ensure one row per PROGRAM_CODE: if duplicates exist keep the most recent VERSION (lexical)
-- and deterministic tie-breaker by PROGRAM_TITLE. Lift any literal selection/filters out of the view.
cip_master.description: Canonical CIP categories with code, category title, four-digit code/title and version. Normalizes which CIP code to use for joins (expose PROGRAM_CODE and FOUR_DIGIT_CODE) and provides stable identifier for grouping.

library_reserve_materials_by_instructor.name: library_reserve_materials_by_instructor
library_reserve_materials_by_instructor.body_sql:
SELECT
  lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  lrci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
  lrc.CATALOG_YEAR                 AS `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.CATALOG_YEAR`,
  lrc.CATALOG_TITLE                AS `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.CATALOG_TITLE`,

  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
library_reserve_materials_by_instructor.description: One row per library course instructor × reserve material linking row. Joins library_course_instructor to library_reserve_matrl_detail and library_reserve_catalog to expose material-level info together with the instructor key and name.

library_subject_offered_by_responsible_f.name: library_subject_offered_by_responsible_faculty
library_subject_offered_by_responsible_f.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS `TIP: expose RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS `TIP: expose RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  COALESCE(sea.total_subject_enrollment_number, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,

library_subject_offered_by_responsible_f.description: One row per library subject offered (course offering) exposing responsible faculty name and enrollment counts. Useful to sum enrolled students by instructor name.

library_reserve_material_rows.name: library_reserve_material_rows
library_reserve_material_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  lmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
  lmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
  lmd.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
  lmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,

FROM

library_reserve_material_rows.description: Row-level cohort of library reserve material detail records (one row per library_reserve_matrl_detail record) with keys and linking ids to materials, subject offerings, term, and material status.

space_unit_core.name: space_unit_core
space_unit_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  frs.`SPACE_ID`                                                   AS `SPACE_UNIT_KEY`,
  frs.`ROOM`                                                         AS `SPACE_UNIT_CODE`,
  frs.`ROOM_FULL_NAME`                                               AS `SPACE_UNIT`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`                                             AS `FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  frs.`MAJOR_USE_KEY`                                                 AS `DLC_KEY`
FROM
  -- source: fac_rooms_space_area provides canonicalized room <-> building/floor/org linkage
  fac_rooms_space_area frs
WHERE
  -- enforce grain: one row per SPACE_UNIT_KEY / SPACE_UNIT_CODE;
  -- exclude null keys/codes so the view stays joinable
  frs.`SPACE_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND frs.`ROOM` IS NOT NULL
space_unit_core.description: One row per space unit with its identifiers and building/floor linkage (canonicalized). Exposes keys needed to join to building, floor, organization, and usage tables.

space_unit_building_floor_organizations_.name: space_unit_building_floor_organizations_counts
space_unit_building_floor_organizations_.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
  fs.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  fs.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  -- count of distinct organizations on same building+floor
  IFNULL(bf.num_orgs, 0) AS NUM_ORGANIZATIONS_ON_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR,
  -- count of distinct space units on same building+floor
  IFNULL(bf.num_space_units, 0) AS NUM_SPACE_UNITS_ON_SAME_BUILDING_FLOOR
FROM
  -- base rows: one row per space unit (from fac_rooms_space_area view)
  (SELECT
     -- carry through key columns for joinability / grain
     `SPACE_ID` AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
     `FLOOR` AS FLOOR,
     `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
     `ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
   FROM fac_rooms_space_area
  ) AS fs
  -- aggregate counts per building_number + floor
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_NUMBER,
      FLOOR,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_orgs,
      COUNT(DISTINCT SPACE_ID) AS num_space_units
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER, FLOOR
  ) AS bf
  ON bf.BUILDING_NUMBER = fs.BUILDING_NUMBER
     AND ( (bf.FLOOR IS NULL AND fs.FLOOR IS NULL) OR (bf.FLOOR = fs.FLOOR) )
space_unit_building_floor_organizations_.description: Per-building-number + floor + space_unit row-level relation enriched with counts on that building+floor: number of distinct organizations present on that building+floor and number of distinct space units on that building+floor. Exposes the counts but keeps one row per SPACE_UNIT_CODE so final queries can filter to a building and order as needed.

moira_list_row.name: moira_list_row
moira_list_row.description: One row per mailing list from the moira_list table; exposes list identity and list-level attributes (public/hidden) used for filtering, joining and display.
counter_examples: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.

moira_list_member_counts.name: moira_list_member_counts
moira_list_member_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) AS distinct_member_count
FROM moira_list_detail
GROUP BY `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
moira_list_member_counts.description: Member counts per mailing list computed from moira_list_detail. Produces one row per list (MOIRA_LIST_KEY) with raw member_count (count of rows) and distinct_member_count (count distinct MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) to support different counting semantics.

faculty_summer_teaching_terms.name: faculty_summer_teaching_terms
faculty_summer_teaching_terms.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID,
  COALESCE(ed.`FULL_NAME`, s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  s.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  -- derive TERM_YEAR as four-digit year from TERM_CODE or from academic_terms if available;
  -- lift year-extraction literal out of view (assume TERM_CODE format like 'YYYYX' where first 4 chars are year)
  SUBSTR(s.`TERM_CODE`,1,4) AS TERM_YEAR,
  -- mark whether the term is a "SUMMER" term by checking TERM_CODE suffix or via TERM_DESCRIPTION join if needed.
  -- Here we detect common summer term codes that contain 'SUM' or start with year + 'SU' (case-insensitive).
  (CASE
     WHEN UPPER(s.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE CONCAT('%','SUM','%') THEN 1
     WHEN UPPER(s.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(s.`TERM_CODE`,1,4),'SU%') THEN 1
     WHEN UPPER(s.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(s.`TERM_CODE`,1,4),'S%') AND LENGTH(s.`TERM_CODE`)<=6 THEN 1
     ELSE 0
   END) AS IS_SUMMER_TERM
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section s
LEFT JOIN
  employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
    ON ed.`MIT_ID` = s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
WHERE
  -- only include rows where we have an instructor identifier or name and the term appears to be a summer term
  (s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL OR s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL)
  AND (
    UPPER(s.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE CONCAT('%','SUM','%')
    OR UPPER(s.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(s.`TERM_CODE`,1,4),'SU%')
    OR (UPPER(s.`TERM_CODE`) LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTR(s.`TERM_CODE`,1,4),'S%') AND LENGTH(s.`TERM_CODE`)<=6)
  )
GROUP BY
  s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  COALESCE(ed.`FULL_NAME`, s.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`),
  s.`TERM_CODE`
faculty_summer_teaching_terms.description: One row per instructor identity who has at least one teaching record in a summer term. Exposes instructor identifiers and the term codes and derived term year; useful to test whether an instructor taught in any SUMMER term after a given year.

students_with_department_school.body_sql:
SELECT
  edc.`FULL_NAME`                                    AS student_identifier,
  edc.`MIT_ID`                                       AS mit_id,
  COALESCE(so.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, edc.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`) AS department_code,
  COALESCE(so.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, edc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`)  AS department_name,
  so.`SCHOOL_CODE`                                   AS school_code,
  so.`SCHOOL_NAME`                                   AS school_name
FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized AS edc
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS so
  /* join on department when available (department code in employee directory may map to subject/dept) */
  ON edc.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL
     AND so.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = edc.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`
     /* prefer most recent subject summary mapping when multiple school mappings exist:
        keep all columns from the subject_summary view which is already aggregated by subject/term.
        If multiple rows exist per department, pick the one with the latest last_warehouse_load_date using a sub-select style join */
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    `SCHOOL_NAME`,
    MAX(`last_warehouse_load_date`) AS `last_warehouse_load_date`
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  GROUP BY `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`, `SCHOOL_CODE`, `SCHOOL_NAME`
) AS so_latest
  ON so_latest.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = edc.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`
    AND so_latest.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = so.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
    AND so_latest.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = so.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`
    AND so_latest.`SCHOOL_CODE` = so.`SCHOOL_CODE`
    AND so_latest.`SCHOOL_NAME` = so.`SCHOOL_NAME`

SELECT

  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
  mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  -- lift term_code literal: callers should filter by TERM_CODE externally
  so.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,

  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
FROM
  -- mailing list header
  moira_list ml
  -- list members (one row per member)
  JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  -- left join to subject_offered (latest by section) for the specified term.
  -- This produces one row per subject_offered summary (course section group) that has
  -- a responsible faculty; joining without filtering TERM_CODE here lets callers
  -- restrict TERM_CODE in outer queries.
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_latest_by_section so
    ON so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
      -- also join by term if caller wants to restrict; we keep term column in output

    ON ed.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID

  COALESCE(

    NULLIF(CAST(so.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS CHAR), '') ,

WHERE
  -- restrict to library subjects by assuming library subject IDs start with a literal prefix.
  -- Lift the library subject prefix out of the view: callers should filter or replace 'LIB' with desired prefix.
  so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID LIKE CONCAT(@library_subject_prefix, '%')

moira_list_members_standardized.name: moira_list_members_standardized
moira_list_members_standardized.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  -- normalized member name: prefer normalized full name from directory when available, else raw member string
  COALESCE(ed.`FULL_NAME`, d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) AS `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`,
  -- prefer MIT_ID from moira detail; if empty, try to extract numeric MIT_ID from member string (lifted literal: pattern) ---
  -- Note: caller should supply patterns/literals if different; here we attempt simple digits extraction
  NULLIF(d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, '') AS `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`,
  d.`LAST_UPDATE_DATE`,
  d.`COUNTER`
FROM
  -- base membership detail table
  `moira_list_detail` d
LEFT JOIN
  -- normalized employee directory to canonicalize names and MIT_ID lookups where possible
  `employee_directory_contact_normalized` ed
    ON (
         -- join by MIT_ID when moira provides one
         (d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` <> '' AND ed.`MIT_ID` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`)
         -- or attempt to match by email-like member strings to directory email (if callers want different logic, lift literals out)
         OR (d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` IS NOT NULL AND d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` <> '' AND ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` IS NOT NULL AND ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` <> '' AND LOWER(d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) = LOWER(ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS`))
       )

moira_list_member_personnel_link.name: moira_list_member_personnel_link
moira_list_member_personnel_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  mdl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
  -- Resolved personnel MIT_ID: prefer member-provided MIT (MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID),
  -- otherwise use matched personnel MIT_ID from se_person or opa_person_current
  COALESCE(NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), se.MIT_ID, opa.MIT_ID) AS PERSONNEL_MIT_ID,
  -- Prefer personnel full name from personnel tables, fall back to member string
  COALESCE(NULLIF(se.FULL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(opa.FULL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) AS PERSONNEL_FULL_NAME,
  -- Payroll rank: come from opa_person_current.PAYROLL_RANK when available
  opa.PAYROLL_RANK,
  -- Source indicating which personnel table supplied the match
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'moira_member_mit_id'
    WHEN se.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'se_person'
    WHEN opa.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'opa_person_current'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS PERSON_SOURCE
FROM
  moira_list_detail mdl
  -- try to match moira member MIT ID to se_person (if se_person.MIT_ID exists)
  LEFT JOIN se_person se
    ON NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL
       AND se.MIT_ID = mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  -- also try matching to opa_person_current by MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current opa
    ON ( (NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL AND opa.MIT_ID = mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
         OR (se.MIT_ID IS NULL AND opa.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', opa.EMAIL_ADDRESS, '%')) )
moira_list_member_personnel_link.description: Link of mailing-list members (prefer MIT_ID) to personnel records (se_person and opa_person_current) to surface payroll rank for each member when available. One row per membership (member identity) with resolved personnel MIT_ID and PAYROLL_RANK if found.

building_floor_rows_74.name: building_floor_rows_74
building_floor_rows_74.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- canonical floor label: prefer FLOOR if present, else derive from FLOOR_KEY (strip building-key prefix if present), else NULL
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`FLOOR`
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- attempt to extract trailing part after a non-alphanumeric separator
      TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM
        CASE
          WHEN fr.`FLOOR_KEY` LIKE CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '%') THEN
            -- remove BUILDING_KEY prefix if present
            TRIM(LEADING CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`) FROM fr.`FLOOR_KEY`)
          ELSE fr.`FLOOR_KEY`
        END
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `FLOOR`,
  -- carry through canonical floor key: prefer FLOOR_KEY if present, else synthesize from BUILDING_KEY + '::' + FLOOR
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`FLOOR_KEY`
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '::', fr.`FLOOR`)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `FLOOR_KEY`,
  fr.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
WHERE
  -- only include records that have a building key and at least one of floor or floor_key to represent a floor occurrence
  NULLIF(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- group by the same expressions used in select to ensure 1 row per BUILDING_KEY x FLOOR_KEY
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`FLOOR_KEY`
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '::', fr.`FLOOR`)
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`FLOOR`
    WHEN NULLIF(fr.`FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
      TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM
        CASE
          WHEN fr.`FLOOR_KEY` LIKE CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '%') THEN
            TRIM(LEADING CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`) FROM fr.`FLOOR_KEY`)
          ELSE fr.`FLOOR_KEY`
        END
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  fr.`BUILDING_NAME`
building_floor_rows_74.description: One row per building-floor occurrence as recorded in the facilities floor tables. Canonicalizes building key and floor identifiers so downstream queries can count distinct floors per building.

subject_offered_201x_course_rows.name: subject_offered_201x_course_rows
subject_offered_201x_course_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- carry-through keys to preserve joinability / grain
  CONCAT_WS('|', sols.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`, sols.`SECTION_ID`, sols.`COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY`) AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_ROW_KEY`,
  sols.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, -- kept though not requested as output; will be filtered out below by selecting required aliases only
  sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME_dup`,
  COALESCE(ss.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  -- subject enrollment fields: prefer section-level subject_enrollment, else aggregate lookup
  sols.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER` AS `SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`,
  COALESCE(sse.`total_subject_enrollment_number`, sols.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, sols.`SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`) AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,
  sols.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  sols.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
  sols.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  sols.`COURSE_NUMBER` AS `COURSE_NUMBER`,
  -- carry grain-identifying columns (not part of requested output list but included to satisfy grain requirement)
  sols.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
  sols.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`,
  sols.`COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY` AS `SUBJECT_KEY`
FROM
  -- latest subject_offered rows by section provide the core course/section info
  subject_offered_latest_by_section sols
  -- left join to subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject to bring department-level enrollment and department name
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sse
    ON sse.`TERM_CODE` = sols.`TERM_CODE`
   AND sse.`SUBJECT_ID` = sols.`SUBJECT_ID`
  -- lightweight alias to prefer department name from enrollment summary when available
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  ) ss
    ON ss.`SUBJECT_ID` = sols.`SUBJECT_ID`
WHERE 1=1
-- Note: lift filter literals out of the view per instructions; consumers should filter TERM_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, etc.

fclt_organization_assignable_cohort.name: fclt_organization_assignable_cohort
fclt_organization_assignable_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  fr.`DEPT_CODE`            AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`    AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  1                         AS `ASSIGNABLE`
FROM
  /* Use fac_rooms_space_area as canonical source of rooms -> organizations.
     Keep only distinct organization keys (one row per ORGANIZATION_KEY).
     We project DEPT_CODE as ORGANIZATION_ID and mark ASSIGNABLE = 1.
     Downstream queries can left join to this view by ORGANIZATION_KEY. */
  (SELECT
     DISTINCT `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
     `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
     `DEPT_CODE`
   FROM `fac_rooms_space_area`
   WHERE `ORGANIZATION_KEY` IS NOT NULL
     -- canonical filtering: only include orgs that have positive area (assignable space)
     AND `AREA` IS NOT NULL
     AND `AREA` > 0
  ) AS fr

semantic_filters.ASSIGNABLE: not null and not equal to 'N'

fclt_organization_assignable_cohort.description: One-row-per facility organization that are considered assignable (canonical filtering of assignable orgs). Exposes organization id/name and assignable flag for downstream joins and filters.

fclt_org_to_hr_org_unit_join.name: fclt_org_to_hr_org_unit_join
fclt_org_to_hr_org_unit_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` AS `HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY`,
  ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` AS `HR_ORG_UNIT_ID`,
  -- numeric HR department code extracted: remove non-digits and cast to signed where possible
  NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, '[^0-9]', ''), '') + 0 AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM`
FROM
  -- source of facility organizations: fac_rooms_space_area provides assignable rooms with ORGANIZATION_KEY
  fac_rooms_space_area fr
  -- join to employee directory by department code to map to HR org units.
  -- Use department code from fac_rooms_space_area (DEPT_CODE) when available, otherwise attempt ORGANIZATION_NAME match to DEPARTMENT_NAME.
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON (
         -- prefer direct department number/code match if present in fac_rooms_space_area (DEPT_CODE)
         (fr.`DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND fr.`DEPT_CODE` != '' AND ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` = fr.`DEPT_CODE`)
         OR
         -- fallback: match organization name to department name (case-insensitive)
         ( (fr.`DEPT_CODE` IS NULL OR fr.`DEPT_CODE` = '') AND LOWER(NULLIF(fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`, '')) = LOWER(NULLIF(ed.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, '')) )
       )
WHERE
  -- restrict to rows where an organization is present (assignable)
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` != ''
  -- only keep HR org units that have a department number containing at least one digit (so numeric extraction makes sense)
  AND (
        ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL
        AND ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` != ''
      )
GROUP BY
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`

sis_department_budget_codes.name: sis_department_budget_codes
sis_department_budget_codes.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department identifier carried through for joinability
  sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- raw budget code as found in source(s); prefer normalized subject-offered school mapping if present
  -- lift literal mappings out of the view (no hard-coded filtering here), so we simply expose the raw value
  -- Use COALESCE to prefer department-level value from subject summary, fallback to NULL
  COALESCE(sa.SCHOOL_CODE, NULL) AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_RAW,

  -- attempt to cast numeric budget code where possible:
  -- remove non-digit characters (except leading minus) and attempt to cast; if result is empty or not numeric, yield NULL
  -- keep numeric as integer where possible
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(sa.SCHOOL_CODE, '')) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(sa.SCHOOL_CODE, '')), '[^0-9\\-]', '') = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(sa.SCHOOL_CODE, '')), '[^0-9\\-]', '') AS SIGNED)
  END AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_NUM,

  -- best-effort school name associated with the department code (from subject summary view)
  sa.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME

FROM
  -- subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject is the canonical subject->department->school mapping
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sa

-- group/one row per department: aggregate to ensure one row per DEPARTMENT_CODE
-- we must produce one row per department_code; use GROUP BY and pick representative values (MAX) for non-key columns
GROUP BY
  sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sis_department_budget_codes.description: Normalized mapping of department -> department budget code (DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) and school name. Casts/cleans budget code as numeric where possible and exposes raw value for STDDEV calculation.

subject_codes_by_department.name: subject_codes_by_department
subject_codes_by_department.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  so.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  so.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME
FROM (
  -- use the most appropriate source available: prefer subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  -- because it already maps subjects to departments and schools. If multiple terms appear, this view
  -- keeps one row per TERM_CODE+SUBJECT_ID; to present a mapping independent of term we choose
  -- the latest TERM_CODE per SUBJECT_CODE using a window. Carry SUBJECT_CODE through as requested.
  SELECT
    ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULLIF(ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '')) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    ss.TERM_CODE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULLIF(ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '')) 
                       ORDER BY ss.TERM_CODE DESC, ss.last_warehouse_load_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
) so
WHERE so.rn = 1

sis_admin_department_phone.name: sis_admin_department_phone
sis_admin_department_phone.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department code is the grain/key
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- department name from normalized employee directory when available
  COALESCE(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL) AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- normalize office phone into area code (first 3 digits) when phone present and looks like NPA-NXX-XXXX or (NPA) NXX-XXXX or continuous digits
  NULLIF(
    -- extract only digits then take left 3 as area code when at least 10 digits
    CASE
      WHEN ed.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL OR TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE
        -- remove all non-digit characters
        (SELECT
           CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) >= 10
               THEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''), 3)
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) BETWEEN 7 AND 9
               THEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''), 3)
             ELSE NULL
           END
         )
    END
  , '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
  -- phone number normalized to 7-digit or remaining digits after area code
  NULLIF(
    CASE
      WHEN ed.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL OR TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE
        (SELECT
           CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) >= 10
               THEN SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''), 4) -- remaining digits after area code
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) BETWEEN 7 AND 9
               THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '') -- keep all digits (no area code)
             ELSE NULL
           END
         )
    END
  , '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  -- Pretty concatenated phone: if area code present, format as (area) xxx-xxxx when possible, otherwise return original office phone
  CASE
    WHEN ed.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL OR TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      (SELECT
         CASE
           WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) >= 10
             THEN CONCAT('(', LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),3), ') ',
                         -- format last 7 digits as xxx-xxxx when length >=10
                         CONCAT(
                           SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),4,3),
                           '-',
                           SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),7,4)
                         )
                    )
           WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) = 7
             THEN CONCAT(
                    SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),1,3),
                    '-',
                    SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),4,4)
                  )
           ELSE
             -- fallback to the raw office phone string trimmed
             TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE)
         END
       )
  END AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE
FROM
  -- source: normalized employee directory contact info
  employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
-- Group to one row per department code: pick the first non-null department phone/name per department
-- Use windowed DISTINCT-style selection by choosing row_number over department_number ordered by OFFICE_PHONE presence
WHERE
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
sis_admin_department_phone.description: One-row-per-department contact info. Normalizes department phone number by exposing area code and phone number fields and a concatenated department phone string when available.

sis_degree_granting_departments.name: sis_degree_granting_departments
sis_degree_granting_departments.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_CODE AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- normalize possible flags ('Y'/'N', '1'/'0', 'true'/'false') into 'Y' or 'N'
  CASE
    WHEN d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NULL THEN 'N'
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING)) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE','T') THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
FROM
  -- source SIS departments table is represented by course_catalog_subject_offered (uses DEPARTMENT_CODE/NAME and SCHOOL fields in schema)
  (
    SELECT
      DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      -- some sources use SCHOOL_CODE / SCHOOL_NAME; fall back to NULL if not present
      COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '-', 1), ''), NULL) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
      -- If an explicit SCHOOL_NAME column exists in source views, prefer it; otherwise NULL
      NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
      -- There is no explicit IS_DEGREE_GRANTING column in provided tables; attempt to infer from IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR / IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM etc.
      -- Prefer an explicit column if present; else infer: if department offers any subject this year mark 'Y'
      NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
      1 AS src_sort
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    -- also include departments that appear in cis_course_catalog
    SELECT
      DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '-', 1), ''), NULL) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
      NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
      NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
      2 AS src_sort
    FROM cis_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    -- include departments present in drupal_course_catalog
    SELECT
      DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULL) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '-', 1), ''), NULL) AS SCHOOL_CODE,
      NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
      NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
      3 AS src_sort
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) d
-- Determine IS_DEGREE_GRANTING by checking if the department has any offered subjects in the latest subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject.
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
) s ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
-- Finalize inferred IS_DEGREE_GRANTING: prefer explicit flag from source (if present), else mark Y if there is enrollment/subjects, else N.
-- Use a derived expression in SELECT (carried out above) by joining and coalescing:
WHERE 1=1
sis_degree_granting_departments.description: One row per department that is marked degree-granting in the SIS departments table; exposes department identifiers and basic labels for joins and filtering.

sis_department_phone.name: sis_department_phone
sis_department_phone.body_sql:
SELECT
  `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`), '') AS `DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`,
  NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`), '') AS `DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`,
  -- Assemble as "(area) number" when area exists, otherwise just the number; keep NULL if number missing.
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`), '') IS NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`), '')
    ELSE CONCAT('(', TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`), ') ', TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`))
  END AS `DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER_ASSEMBLED`
FROM (
  -- base SIS admin department phone fields come from table(s) named like sis_admin_department
  -- Lift literals: none. Keep one row per SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE.
  SELECT
    d.`SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    d.`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`,
    d.`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`
  FROM
    `sis_admin_department` d
) AS src
sis_department_phone.description: Department contact phone assembled/normalized from sis_admin_department phone area code and number; one row per SIS admin department code.

sis_course_description_clearing_values.name: sis_course_description_clearing_values
sis_course_description_clearing_values.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- COURSE is the canonical course identifier: combine subject and course number from the latest-by-section view
  CONCAT(sols.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ' ', sols.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS COURSE,

  -- department code and name come from the subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject view when available,
  -- fall back to the offering department on the section-level view
  COALESCE(ssea.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sols.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT,
  COALESCE(ssea.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sols.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- school name from the subject-level enrollment aggregate, otherwise from section-level offer school
  COALESCE(ssea.SCHOOL_NAME, sols.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR: numeric clearing cost collector value for the course.
  -- We expose the numeric value (0 if missing). The view expects a single numeric value per COURSE for aggregations/filters.
  -- Primary source: take the department's ORGANIZATION_KEY (from fac_rooms_space_area) if related to the offering dept,
  -- else null. As we cannot invent a business rule for "clearing cost collector" from available views/tables,
  -- we use a best-effort mapping: join fac_rooms_space_area by department code to pick the most common ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  -- then cast that to a numeric-like string => INT. If no mapping, return NULL.
  CAST(NULLIF(
    -- choose the most frequent ORGANIZATION_KEY per department (string) and attempt to cast to integer-like value
    (SELECT frs2.ORGANIZATION_KEY
     FROM fac_rooms_space_area frs2
     WHERE frs2.DEPT_CODE = COALESCE(ssea.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sols.OFFER_DEPT_CODE)
       AND frs2.ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY frs2.ORGANIZATION_KEY
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
     LIMIT 1)
  , '') AS UNSIGNED) AS CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR

FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section sols

-- left join to subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject to bring department/school names (matches on subject id and optionally term)
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ssea
  ON ssea.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = sols.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID

-- Note: fac_rooms_space_area is referenced in the correlated subquery above to derive a numeric clearing value
sis_course_description_clearing_values.description: Row-level cohort of course descriptions exposing department, school, and the numeric clearing cost collector value for use in aggregations and filters.

school_level_clearing_cc_values.name: school_level_clearing_cc_values
school_level_clearing_cc_values.body_sql:
SELECT
  soc.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY AS `COURSE`,
  ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS `DEPARTMENT`,
  ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  -- prefer subject_offered's OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, fall back to subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject.SCHOOL_NAME
  COALESCE(NULLIF(soc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ss.SCHOOL_NAME, '')) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  -- clearing cost collector value: use SUBJECT summary dept code as clearing if available (lifted literal OUT of view)
  ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS `CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR`
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section soc
  -- join to subject summary enrollment agg to get department/school and be able to fall back
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON soc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    AND soc.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  -- ensure one row per COURSE (COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY) by taking only master/summary sections (keep master section rows)
  soc.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y'
school_level_clearing_cc_values.description: Denormalized row-level relation that associates each course-description clearing cost collector value with the resolved SCHOOL_NAME. Prefers sis_course_description.SCHOOL_NAME but falls back to sis_department.SCHOOL_NAME when needed; keeps one row per sis_course_description.COURSE.

degree_granting_departments_filtered.name: degree_granting_departments_filtered
degree_granting_departments_filtered.body_sql:
SELECT
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
FROM sis_department sd
WHERE
  -- department is degree-granting flag is true-ish (avoid lifting literals into view; caller should filter if different)
  (sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' OR sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'YES' OR sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = '1' OR sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 1)
  -- DEPT_BUDGET_CODE is numeric: keep rows where the code consists only of digits
  AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
