subject_offering_rows.name: subject_offering_rows
subject_offering_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  sol.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
  sol.`TERM_CODE`,
  sol.`SUBJECT_ID`,
  sol.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
  -- prefer section-level enrollment if present, else fall back to subject-level aggregate if available
  COALESCE(sol.`SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, sol.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, sse.`total_subject_enrollment_number`) AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,
  sol.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  sol.`MEET_PLACE`
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS sol
LEFT JOIN
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
  ON sol.`TERM_CODE` = sse.`TERM_CODE`
  AND sol.`SUBJECT_ID` = sse.`SUBJECT_ID`
/* Note: literals (filters) should be applied by consumers of this view. */
subject_offering_rows.description: One row per subject offering/section as recorded in subject_offered (an offering instance of a subject in a term). Exposes department, subject identifier, term, enrollment counts and responsible faculty to support grouping and filtering.

subject_enrollment_range_by_subject.name: subject_enrollment_range_by_subject
subject_enrollment_range_by_subject.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
  s.SUBJECT_ID AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS `subject_max_enrolled`,
  MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS `subject_min_enrolled`,
  (MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS `subject_enrollment_range`
FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section s
GROUP BY
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  s.SUBJECT_ID
subject_enrollment_range_by_subject.description: Per-subject enrollment range computed from subject offering rows: for each SUBJECT_ID (within an offer department) compute max and min NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS across its offerings and produce the range. This view does NOT apply department-name literals and exposes raw measures so final queries can average ranges per department.

academic_terms_status.name: academic_terms_status
academic_terms_status.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.`TERM_CODE`                         AS `TERM_CODE`,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`, ata.`TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`, atp.`TERM_INDICATOR`) AS `TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`,
  -- keep original string dates as-is so callers can parse/format as needed
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_START_DATE`, ata.`TERM_START_DATE`, atp.`TERM_START_DATE`) AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_END_DATE`, ata.`TERM_END_DATE`, atp.`TERM_END_DATE`)     AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, atp.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS `TER M_DESCRIPTION`
FROM
  -- primary canonical table (prefer academic_terms)
  `academic_terms` at
-- left-join the "all" table by TERM_CODE to pick up missing status/date info
LEFT JOIN `academic_terms_all` ata
  ON ata.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
-- left-join parameter table as an additional fallback
LEFT JOIN `academic_term_parameter` atp
  ON atp.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
-- include any TERM_CODEs that might exist only in the other sources
UNION
-- rows present in academic_terms_all but not in academic_terms
SELECT
  ata.`TERM_CODE`                         AS `TERM_CODE`,
  COALESCE(ata.`TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`, atp.`TERM_INDICATOR`) AS `TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`,
  COALESCE(ata.`TERM_START_DATE`, atp.`TERM_START_DATE`)     AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
  COALESCE(ata.`TERM_END_DATE`, atp.`TERM_END_DATE`)         AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
  COALESCE(ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, atp.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`)   AS `TER M_DESCRIPTION`
FROM `academic_terms_all` ata
LEFT JOIN `academic_term_parameter` atp
  ON atp.`TERM_CODE` = ata.`TERM_CODE`
WHERE ata.`TERM_CODE` NOT IN (SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms`)
UNION
-- rows present only in academic_term_parameter (as last resort)
SELECT
  atp.`TERM_CODE`                         AS `TERM_CODE`,
  atp.`TERM_INDICATOR`                    AS `TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`,
  atp.`TERM_START_DATE`                   AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
  atp.`TERM_END_DATE`                     AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
  atp.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`                  AS `TER M_DESCRIPTION`
FROM `academic_term_parameter` atp
WHERE atp.`TERM_CODE` NOT IN (
  SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms`
  UNION
  SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms_all`
)
academic_terms_status.description: Canonical view of academic_terms keyed by TERM_CODE exposing TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR and TERM_START_DATE/TERM_END_DATE for filtering terms by status and for joining to offerings. Normalizes the academic_terms table(s) into a single TERM_CODE-keyed relation.

sis_department_degree_granting.name: sis_department_degree_granting
sis_department_degree_granting.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- department identifier (grain)
  so.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- department name (prefer from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject, fall back to offer name)
  COALESCE(agg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, '' ) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- indicator: department is degree-granting if it appears in subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  CASE WHEN agg.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
FROM
  (
    -- derive the canonical list of departments from subject_offered_latest_by_section (offers) 
    -- this produces one row per department code seen in the offers dataset
    SELECT DISTINCT
      OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS so
LEFT JOIN
  (
    -- aggregate-level source that represents departments with enrolled subjects (degree-granting)
    -- we select distinct department codes from the enrollment aggregation view
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS agg
  ON agg.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sis_department_degree_granting.description: All departments that are degree-granting (row per department). Exposes department identifiers and degree-granting indicator for downstream filtering and joins.

sis_subject_code_with_department.name: sis_subject_code_with_department
sis_subject_code_with_department.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.COURSE_NUMBER                    AS SUBJECT_CODE,        -- lifted: COURSE_NUMBER is the subject code at the requested grain
  so.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC               AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ss.SCHOOL_CODE                      AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  ss.SCHOOL_NAME                      AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- carry-through keys for joinability / traceability
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.SUBJECT_ID,
  so.TERM_CODE
FROM
  -- use the latest-by-section subject_offered view as the primary source of subject/department/course rows
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS so
LEFT JOIN
  -- subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject holds authoritative department & school metadata per subject
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS ss
    ON ss.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE
  -- exclude rows lacking a course number (grain expects COURSE_NUMBER)
  so.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
sis_subject_code_with_department.description: Subject-code rows with department and subject metadata (one row per subject code). Exposes subject code, its description, the department that offers it and school info; useful for grouping by department+subject.

mit_fac_building_core.name: mit_fac_building_core
mit_fac_building_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  fb.SITE AS SITE,
  fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  fb.DATE_BUILT AS DATE_BUILT,
  fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  fb.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_building fb
WHERE fb.SITE IS NOT NULL
  AND fb.SITE <> ''
mit_fac_building_core.description: One row per facility building from fac_building restricted to campus SITE and exposing identifying and descriptive columns used for joins and filters. Keeps raw building-level attributes without aggregation so downstream queries can apply additional filters (e.g., exclude specific buildings).

fac_building_room_counts.name: fac_building_room_counts
fac_building_room_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
  COUNT(*) AS `NUM_ROOMS`,
  -- pick a sample room identifier per building (first non-null SPACE_ID then ROOM)
  COALESCE(
    MIN(fr.`SPACE_ID`),
    MIN(fr.`ROOM`)
  ) AS `ROOM_SAMPLE_ID`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`
fac_building_room_counts.description: Counts rooms per building using fac_rooms. One row per building (FAC_BUILDING_KEY) with raw room count and optionally distinct-room identifier if present. Keeps raw count (no thresholds) so caller can apply >10 filter.

fclt_building_hist_by_building.name: fclt_building_hist_by_building
fclt_building_hist_by_building.body_sql:
SELECT
  `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  COUNT(*) AS `NUM_HIST_RECORDS`,
  SUM(`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`) AS `TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA`
FROM fclt_building_hist
GROUP BY `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`
fclt_building_hist_by_building.description: Historical records aggregated at the building level (FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) from fclt_building_hist. For each building key produce count of history rows and sum of ASSIGNABLE_AREA and expose the raw ASSIGNABLE_AREA per history row via the sum and the count so callers can compute per-record averages and run cross-building comparisons.

student_records_cohort.name: student_records_cohort
student_records_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  edn.MIT_ID                                                        AS MIT_ID,
  COALESCE(edn.FULL_NAME, CONCAT_WS(' ',
       edn.PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, edn.PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, edn.PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
       edn.FIRST_NAME, edn.MIDDLE_NAME, edn.LAST_NAME))               AS FULL_NAME,
  COALESCE(edn.DEPARTMENT_NAME, frs.DEPT_CODE, '')                  AS DEPARTMENT,
  NULL                                                              AS STUDENT_YEAR
FROM
  employee_directory_contact_normalized edn
LEFT JOIN
  fac_rooms_space_area frs
    ON edn.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = frs.DEPT_CODE
student_records_cohort.description: One-row-per-student enrollment/person record exposing student identifying fields and enrollment year/program so callers can filter cohorts (e.g., graduate students, by department). Does not aggregate — keeps one row per student record.

sis_department_metadata.name: sis_department_metadata
sis_department_metadata.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical department code (from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject when available,
  -- otherwise from fac_rooms_space_area.department or employee_directory_contact_normalized.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)
  COALESCE(sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, frs.DEPT_CODE, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- short name: prefer enrollment summary department name, then fac rooms org name, then employee directory dept name
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME,''), NULLIF(frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME,''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- full name: construct by preferring school + ' - ' + dept short name when school exists, otherwise fallback to longer names available
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(CONCAT(NULLIF(sse.SCHOOL_NAME,''), ' - ', NULLIF(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')), ''),
    NULLIF(frs.ROOM_FULL_NAME,''), 
    NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')
  ) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,

  -- school name: prefer school name from enrollment summary, then try to infer from fac rooms (none) then null
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sse.SCHOOL_NAME,''), NULLIF(frs.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')) AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- is department degree granting: heuristic — treat departments appearing in subject enrollment summary as degree-granting (Y),
  -- otherwise mark as N. (Lifted literal: presence in sse)
  CASE WHEN sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING

FROM
  -- left-most source: aggregated subject enrollment by term/subject (gives authoritative dept code/name/school)
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sse

-- join fac rooms to pick up departments that may not appear in subject enrollment (space-managed departments)
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area frs
  ON frs.DEPT_CODE = sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE

-- join employee directory as additional fallback for department naming/numbering
LEFT JOIN employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
  ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = COALESCE(sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, frs.DEPT_CODE)

-- union-like behavior: include departments that exist only in fac_rooms_space_area or employee_directory as well
-- achieved by additional UNION-ALL style rows appended via LEFT JOINs to a derived driving set below
RIGHT JOIN (
  -- driving set collects distinct department codes from all three sources so final result has one row per department code
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM fac_rooms_space_area WHERE DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) AS union_depts
) AS driving
  ON driving.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COALESCE(sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, frs.DEPT_CODE, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)
sis_department_metadata.description: Canonical department metadata rows exposing department code, short name, full name, school and degree-granting indicator. Useful for joins to student records and filtering to degree-granting departments.

students_with_department.name: students_with_department
students_with_department.body_sql:
SELECT
  sd.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
  sd.FULL_NAME AS FULL_NAME,
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, fr.DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT,
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  COALESCE(ss.SCHOOL_NAME, fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION, NULL) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- IS_DEGREE_GRANTING lifted out as a literal in queries; include departmental flag if present in subject_summary (Y/N style) else NULL
  NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
  sd.DIRECTORY_TITLE AS STUDENT_YEAR
FROM
  -- canonical student/person directory (may contain students & employees). Use employee_directory where student rows are stored.
  employee_directory sd
  -- Join to subject_summary enrollment to pick up department/school metadata where available.
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  -- Also try fac_rooms_space_area which contains DEPT_CODE / ORGANIZATION_NAME for alternate mapping
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area fr
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = fr.DEPT_CODE
WHERE
  -- restrict to rows that look like student records: STUDENT_YEAR (directory title) not null OR MIT_ID present.
  sd.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
students_with_department.description: Denormalized rows joining student directory records to SIS department metadata so queries can aggregate students by department attributes (full name, school, degree-granting flag). Keeps one row per student record.

student_academic_affiliation.name: student_academic_affiliation
student_academic_affiliation.body_sql:
SELECT
  edn.`MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
  -- school code: prefer school from subject enrollment aggregation if present via department join;
  -- fall back to NULL (lift literal: none)
  sse.`SCHOOL_CODE` AS `SCHOOL_CODE`,
  -- department code: use department number from employee directory if available,
  -- otherwise use department code from subject enrollment summary
  COALESCE(edn.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, sse.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  -- is graduate: identify as graduate if school code or department indicates graduate
  -- (this logic is left generic: treat SCHOOL_CODE starting with 'G' or containing 'GRAD' as graduate)
  CASE
    WHEN sse.`SCHOOL_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND (
         UPPER(sse.`SCHOOL_CODE`) LIKE 'G%' OR UPPER(sse.`SCHOOL_CODE`) LIKE '%GRAD%')
      THEN 'Y'
    WHEN COALESCE(edn.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, sse.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) IS NOT NULL AND (
         UPPER(COALESCE(edn.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, sse.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`)) LIKE 'GRAD%' OR
         UPPER(COALESCE(edn.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, sse.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`)) LIKE 'G%')
      THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_GRADUATE`
FROM
  -- canonical list of students: use employee_directory_contact_normalized if present (students may appear there),
  -- otherwise derive MIT_IDs from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject; perform full union via LEFT JOINs
  (SELECT DISTINCT `MIT_ID`
   FROM `employee_directory_contact_normalized`
   WHERE `MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  ) ed_ids
  LEFT JOIN `employee_directory_contact_normalized` edn
    ON edn.`MIT_ID` = ed_ids.`MIT_ID`
  -- join subject enrollment summary to get school/department affiliation when available
  LEFT JOIN `subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject` sse
    ON sse.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = edn.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`
student_academic_affiliation.description: One row per student enrollment/record capturing student's id, school code, department code, and degree/level indicators to identify graduate students and associate them with a department.

department_master.name: department_master
department_master.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(so.DEPT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_KEY, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  -- Prefer a longer/full name when available: use department_name if it appears full, otherwise fall back to same value
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME`,
  -- IS_DEGREE_GRANTING: flag as 'Y' when department appears in subject summary enrollment (offers subjects) or appears in subject_offered data; else 'N'
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, so.DEPT_CODE) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM
  -- gather possible department codes/names from subject_offered_latest_by_section (offers)
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
      OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS so
  -- full set of departments that come from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject (aggregated subjects)
  LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ss
    ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPT_CODE
  -- employee_directory contact info may include department numbers/names not present above
  LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ed
    ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = so.DEPT_CODE
  -- fac_rooms_space_area (facilities) can provide organization keys/names mapped to departments
  LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPT_CODE AS ORGANIZATION_KEY,
      ORGANIZATION_NAME
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    WHERE DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS fb
    ON fb.ORGANIZATION_KEY = so.DEPT_CODE

UNION

-- Include departments that appear in subject_summary_enrollment_agg but not in subject_offered_latest_by_section
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_KEY, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME`,
  CASE
    WHEN ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ss
  LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ed
    ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPT_CODE AS ORGANIZATION_KEY,
      ORGANIZATION_NAME
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    WHERE DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS fb
    ON fb.ORGANIZATION_KEY = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE

UNION

-- Include departments present only in employee directory (no subjects)
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_KEY, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME`,
  'N' AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ed
  LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPT_CODE AS ORGANIZATION_KEY,
      ORGANIZATION_NAME
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    WHERE DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS fb
    ON fb.ORGANIZATION_KEY = ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
department_master.description: Canonical department list exposing department code, short name, full name and degree-granting flag (normalized column names for reuse in joins and filters).

subject_summary_enrollment.name: subject_summary_enrollment
subject_summary_enrollment.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.subject_summary_key AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.term_code AS TERM_CODE,
  s.subject_id AS SUBJECT_ID,
  s.subject_title AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  s.offer_dept_code AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.offer_dept_name AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- carry through the raw subject-level enrollment number from the source summary view
  s.subject_enrollment_number AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  -- carry through number of distinct enrolled students if available (keep null if not)
  s.num_enrolled_students AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  s.warehouse_load_date AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section s
-- ensure one row per subject_summary_key; the source view already is at that grain (subject_summary_key)
subject_summary_enrollment.description: One row per subject_summary (subject offering summary row) exposing term, subject, department that offers it, and raw enrollment counts and unit fields. Useful for computing per-department subject-level enrollment aggregates.

dept_subject_enrollment_agg.name: dept_subject_enrollment_agg
dept_subject_enrollment_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  MAX(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS MAX_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  MIN(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS MIN_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  AVG(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS AVG_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  COUNT(*) AS COUNT_SUBJECT_ROWS,
  MAX(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  -- source: latest section-level subject offering rows (one row per section/subject instance)
  SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
    s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section s
) AS so
GROUP BY
  so.DEPT_CODE
dept_subject_enrollment_agg.description: Aggregated metrics per department: raw max, min, avg and counts of SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER and NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS for subjects offered by each department. Keeps department code as grouping key so it can be filtered/joined for final answer-level constraints.

counter_examples: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units offered per academic term in that year for the Mathematics department (Course 18), and classify each year as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. subject_summary_courses_positive_units.name: subject_summary_courses_positive_units
subject_summary_courses_positive_units.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY` AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
  s.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  s.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  s.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
  s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  s.`TOTAL_UNITS` AS `TOTAL_UNITS`
FROM (
  -- base: use subject_offered_latest_by_section view if available (it contains SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY and MASTER_SUBJECT_ID),
  -- otherwise fallback to course_catalog_subject_offered / cis_course_catalog-like fields.
  -- This inner query selects one row per SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY carrying required identifiers and unit measure.
  SELECT
    so.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
    so.`TERM_CODE`,
    so.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    COALESCE(so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, so.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    COALESCE(so.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, so.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    -- Prefer TOTAL_UNITS if present on the subject_offer view; fall back to TOTAL_UNITS from course catalog tables if present.
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(so.`TOTAL_UNITS`, ''),
      NULLIF(so.`TOTAL_UNITS`, '0'),
      NULLIF(so.`TOTAL_UNITS`, 'NULL'),
      ccs.`TOTAL_UNITS`,
      cis.`TOTAL_UNITS`
    ) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`
  FROM
    -- try the aggregated/denormalized offering summary view first
    (SELECT
       `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
       `TERM_CODE`,
       `SUBJECT_ID`,
       `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
       `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
       `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
       NULL AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
       NULL AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
       NULL AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,
       `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS `__src_rank`
     FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
     UNION ALL
     -- if subject_offered_latest_by_section not present in the environment, include course_catalog_subject_offered rows
     SELECT
       `SECTION_ID` AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
       `TERM_CODE`,
       `SUBJECT_ID`,
       `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
       `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
       `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
       `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
       `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
       `TOTAL_UNITS`,
       `SECTION_ID` AS `__src_rank`
     FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
     UNION ALL
     -- include cis_course_catalog fallback (subject-level)
     SELECT
       `SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
       `ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `TERM_CODE`,
       `SUBJECT_ID`,
       `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
       `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
       `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
       `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
       `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
       `TOTAL_UNITS`,
       `SUBJECT_ID` AS `__src_rank`
     FROM cis_course_catalog
    ) AS so
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccs
    ON so.`SUBJECT_ID` = ccs.`SUBJECT_ID`
    AND so.`TERM_CODE` = ccs.`TERM_CODE`
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog AS cis
    ON so.`SUBJECT_ID` = cis.`SUBJECT_ID`
    AND (so.`TERM_CODE` = cis.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` OR so.`TERM_CODE` = cis.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`)
) s
WHERE
  -- ensure TOTAL_UNITS is numeric and positive
  CAST(s.`TOTAL_UNITS` AS DECIMAL(12,4)) > 0
subject_summary_courses_positive_units.description: One row per course-offering summary (subject summary) including department and units, filtered to courses with TOTAL_UNITS > 0. Keeps identifiers and course unit measures for downstream aggregation by department.

subject_offered_enrollments_per_section.name: subject_offered_enrollments_per_section
subject_offered_enrollments_per_section.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY               AS SUBJECT_KEY,
  s.TERM_CODE,

Useful to join enrollment records to the department that offered the course.

sis_degree_granting_departments_109.name: sis_degree_granting_departments_109
sis_degree_granting_departments_109.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- use department code as the grain key
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,

  -- prefer a cleaned/trimmed department name if available
  TRIM(NULLIF(`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, '')) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,

  -- flag indicating whether the department is degree-granting.
  -- We infer degree-granting by presence in latest subject summary enrollment aggregation:
  -- departments that have any enrollment rows are considered degree-granting (1) else 0.
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ssea.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY `DEPARTMENT_CODE`) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
    AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`,

  -- DLC_KEY is not present in base tables; expose a placeholder DLC_KEY derived from DEPARTMENT_CODE
  -- so rows remain joinable. Lift any specific literal use out of the view.
  CONCAT('DLC_', `DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DLC_KEY`,

  -- newest warehouse load date seen for this department across source enrollment summary (if present)
  MAX(COALESCE(ssea.`last_warehouse_load_date`, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY `DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  (
    -- gather department codes/names from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject as primary source
    SELECT
      COALESCE(`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      COALESCE(`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
      COALESCE(`last_warehouse_load_date`, '') AS `last_warehouse_load_date`
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    WHERE `DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND `DEPARTMENT_CODE` <> ''
    -- Note: do not hard-code term or year filters here; lift literals out of the view.
    UNION ALL
    -- also include departments from subject_offered_latest_by_section as fallback to catch
    -- departments that offer sections but might not be aggregated yet
    SELECT
      COALESCE(`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      COALESCE(`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
      COALESCE(`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '') AS `last_warehouse_load_date`
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
    WHERE `OFFER_DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND `OFFER_DEPT_CODE` <> ''
    UNION ALL
    -- include departments present in fac_rooms_space_area (rooms assigned to departments)
    SELECT
      COALESCE(`DEPT_CODE`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      COALESCE(`ORGANIZATION_NAME`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
      COALESCE(`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, '') AS `last_warehouse_load_date`
    FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    WHERE `DEPT_CODE` IS NOT NULL AND `DEPT_CODE` <> ''
  ) AS ssea
GROUP BY
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
sis_degree_granting_departments_109.description: Department-level rows for SIS departments that are degree-granting. Exposes department code, name and DLC_NAME for identifying/excluding departments (e.g. Chemistry, Biology) and is_degree_granting flag for filtering.

fac_rooms_with_building_name.name: fac_rooms_with_building_name
fac_rooms_with_building_name.body_sql:
SELECT
  frs.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`,
  frs.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  -- Prefer BUILDING_NAME from fac_rooms_space_area (frs) when present; otherwise fall back to fac_building.BUILDING_NAME
  COALESCE(NULLIF(frs.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''), fb.`BUILDING_NAME`) AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  frs.`ROOM`,
  frs.`AREA`,
  frs.`ACCESS_LEVEL`,
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`
FROM
  -- canonical room-level source that already has area, access level, organization, and optional building name
  `fac_rooms_space_area` frs
  -- left join to fac_building to obtain building-level BUILDING_NAME when room-level BUILDING_NAME is missing
  LEFT JOIN `fac_building` fb
    ON frs.`BUILDING_KEY` = fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
fac_rooms_with_building_name.description: Denormalized room-level view that joins fac_rooms to fac_building to ensure a BUILDING_NAME is available; if BUILDING_NAME exists in fac_rooms it is preserved, otherwise BUILDING_NAME from fac_building is used. Exposes room identifiers, building identifiers/names, area, access level, and organization for grouping and ranking.

rooms_by_building_aggregates.name: rooms_by_building_aggregates
rooms_by_building_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`BUILDING_NAME`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  COUNT(fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY`) AS `ORG_QUALIFYING_ROOM_COUNT`,
  AVG(NULLIF(fr.`AREA`, 0)) AS `ORG_AVG_AREA`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
WHERE
  -- liftable filter: qualifying rooms (example: only include rooms with a positive area and a known organization)
  fr.`AREA` IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.`AREA` > 0
  AND fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`BUILDING_NAME`,
  fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`
rooms_by_building_aggregates.description: Per-building aggregates over room-level rows: total room count, average area, and per-organization counts (organization left as a dimension) to support finding the top organization per building. This view groups at building + organization so the final query can compute per-building totals and determine top organization by joining/aggregating appropriately.

sis_department_canonical.name: sis_department_canonical
sis_department_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical department code (grain)
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- canonical short name
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- prefer a fuller name when available: if sis has a longer name use it, else fall back to department_name
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,

  -- pass through degree-granting flag/text as-is so question-time logic can interpret ('Y'/'N'/NULL/etc.)
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,

  -- canonical department phone for joins; keep as text, no parsing
  sd.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER

FROM (
  -- base canonicalization over sis_department-ish sources:
  -- Start with subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject if present (gives department code/name)
  -- then left-join department-level contact info from employee_directory_contact_normalized and fac_rooms_space_area (for phone fallback).
  --
  -- We assemble a single row per DEPARTMENT_CODE. Question-time logic can override precedence by checking fields.
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    -- prefer department name from subject summary enrollment if present
    NULLIF(TRIM(s.DEPARTMENT_NAME), '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- placeholder for full name: prefer dept name from fac_rooms (organization_name) if longer, else department_name
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    -- no canonical IS_DEGREE_GRANTING in source; leave NULL unless present in a source table (none here) — keep column for consumers
    NULL AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    -- department phone from employee_directory_contact_normalized (take any non-null phone for the department)
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject s

  -- reduce to one row per department_code by grouping/choosing first non-null values
  GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
) sd

-- enrich with phone and fuller names where available from other sources
LEFT JOIN (
  -- collect one phone per department_number from employee_directory_contact_normalized
  SELECT
    ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
    -- choose the longest non-null office phone (heuristic) using GROUP_CONCAT ordering by length
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ed.OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '')) DESC SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    -- choose longest directory full name as potential departmental full name (heuristic)
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME, '')) DESC SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME
  FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
  WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) <> ''
  GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
) ed_phone
  ON ed_phone.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

LEFT JOIN (
  -- building/space-derived organization names: may contain a fuller department/organization name
  SELECT
    frs.DEPT_CODE,
    -- choose longest organization_name
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(frs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')) DESC SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    -- choose any meet-place/room contact as a fallback phone-like field (not ideal but included); keep as text
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT frs.ROOM_FULL_NAME ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(frs.ROOM_FULL_NAME, '')) DESC SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS ROOM_FULL_NAME
  FROM fac_rooms_space_area frs
  WHERE frs.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(frs.DEPT_CODE) <> ''
  GROUP BY frs.DEPT_CODE
) frs_org
  ON frs_org.DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

-- final projection: prefer phone from employee directory, else NULL; prefer full name from DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME, else organization name, else department_name
sis_department_canonical.description: One row per departmental administrative department, canonicalizing department identifiers and exposing degree-granting flag and department phone fields for joins. Keep textual flags as-is (no interpretation) so question-time logic can apply ('Y'/'N' etc.).

building_room_joins.name: building_room_joins
building_room_joins.body_sql:
SELECT

  fb.`BUILDING_TYPE` AS `fac_building.BUILDING_TYPE`,

department_subjects_rank_prep.name: department_subjects_rank_prep
department_subjects_rank_prep.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  -- choose subject title from subject_summary if available else from subject_offered
  COALESCE(sse.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- department name from subject_summary enrollment aggregation (preferred) else offer dept name
  COALESCE(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME: try department name, fall back to OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME (as a surrogate), else NULL
  COALESCE(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  -- COURSE: represent as MASTER_SUBJECT_ID + ' ' + MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER when available, else SUBJECT_ID
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(CONCAT(so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ' ', so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER), ' '),
    so.SUBJECT_ID
  ) AS COURSE,
  -- short course description: use SUBJECT_TITLE (from summary or offered)
  COALESCE(sse.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION,
  -- long course description: prefer SUBJECT_TITLE then NULL (no long description table provided)
  COALESCE(sse.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG,
  -- school name: prefer summary's SCHOOL_NAME then OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
  COALESCE(sse.SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME
FROM
  -- base: latest subject offered by section (one row per subject/section); we aggregate to one row per SUBJECT_ID
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS so
  -- left join to enrollment/summary which contains department and school mappings
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sse.SUBJECT_ID
-- We need one row per SUBJECT_ID; pick the most recent subject row by warehouse load or by MASTER_SUBJECT_ID sort.
-- Use a derived grouping to reduce to one row per SUBJECT_ID choosing the first encountered (GROUP BY with ANY_VALUE)
GROUP BY
  so.SUBJECT_ID
department_subjects_rank_prep.description: Denormalized relationship between course descriptions (department-level info) and subjects offered. One row per SUBJECT_ID mapped to its department/course description, used to compute per-department ranks by SUBJECT_ID.

dept_subject_units_stats.name: dept_subject_units_stats
dept_subject_units_stats.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  s.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS NUM_SUBJECTS,
  AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM (
  -- source: subject-level rows with TOTAL_UNITS; lift any filter literals out of the view
  -- Attempt to use subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject if TOTAL_UNITS exists there;
  -- otherwise assume a subject-level table named cis_course_catalog or course_catalog_subject_offered might contain TOTAL_UNITS.
  -- Prefer subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject when available and join to a catalog table for TOTAL_UNITS.
  SELECT
    ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- total subject-level units: if present in summary use total_subject_enrollment_credit as a proxy,
    -- otherwise NULL (upstream query can provide actual TOTAL_UNITS via a view join).
    NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
) s
-- aggregate per-department (grain is DEPARTMENT_CODE). If multiple department names/school names exist per code,
-- this will arbitrarily pick one via GROUP BY; to keep deterministic, include them in GROUP BY.
GROUP BY
  s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  s.SCHOOL_NAME
dept_subject_units_stats.description: Aggregated per-department-per-school statistics over subject TOTAL_UNITS. Computes raw aggregations (count, avg, stddev) at the department (within school) level from subject-level rows; leaves variance to be computed from STDDEV in the final query to match DB STDDEV semantics.

subject_offering_rows_118.name: subject_offering_rows_118
subject_offering_rows_118.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key for the subject offered row (carry through summary key + section id to keep joinable)
  CONCAT(
    IFNULL(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, ''), '::', IFNULL(sos.SECTION_ID, '')
  ) AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_ROW_KEY,

  -- term and identifiers
  sos.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  sos.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  sos.COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  sos.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,

  -- offering department / school info (from latest_by_section view carried through)
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- school name: prefer explicit school name from subject_summary enrollment if available,
  -- otherwise fall back to OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME from the section-level view
  COALESCE(ssea.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- enrollment: prefer section-level enrollment where available, otherwise use subject-level aggregated enrollment
  COALESCE(sos.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ssea.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,

  -- carry key columns through so this CTE/view remains joinable at those keys
  sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  sos.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID

FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section sos
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ssea
  ON sos.TERM_CODE = ssea.TERM_CODE
  AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ssea.SUBJECT_ID
subject_offering_rows_118.description: Row-level cohort of subject offerings (individual offered sections) with key identifiers, offering department and school, and enrollment counts. Keeps one row per subject_offered row to allow later aggregations at subject or section level.

subject_enrollment_by_subject_and_dept.name: subject_enrollment_by_subject_and_dept
subject_enrollment_by_subject_and_dept.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.section_row_rank /* carry key through so view is joinable, but will be grouped below */,
  s.SUBJECT_ID,
  COALESCE(s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, '') AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE_COALESCE,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  /* compute for each SUBJECT_ID x OFFER_DEPT: minimum SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER observed across sections belonging to that subject offered by that dept */
  MIN(s.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS MIN_ENROLLED_FOR_DEPT,
  /* count distinct sections offering that subject by that department */
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.SECTION_ID) AS NUM_SECTIONS_FOR_DEPT
FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section s
WHERE s.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  s.SUBJECT_ID,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  s.section_row_rank,
  COALESCE(s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, '')
subject_enrollment_by_subject_and_dept.description: Aggregated measures at the subject (SUBJECT_ID) x offering-department level: minimum enrollment observed across sections for that subject offered by a particular department, and distinct count of offering sections. This supports counting departments offering a subject and computing subject-level minima when later aggregated across departments.

subject_min_enrollment_and_dept_counts.name: subject_min_enrollment_and_dept_counts
subject_min_enrollment_and_dept_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  MIN(so.SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS MIN_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS NUM_DEPARTMENTS_OFFERING
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section so
WHERE
  -- lift any question-specific filters out of the view; keep only upstream filtered rows from the source view
  1 = 1
GROUP BY
  so.SUBJECT_ID

Leaves classification (LOW/AVERAGE/HIGH) to question_ops if desired, but also provides the raw min for easy labeling.

fclt_organization_row_level.name: fclt_organization_row_level
fclt_organization_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  `ORGANIZATION_KEY`                                      AS `FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
  `ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`                                   AS `ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`,
  `ORGANIZATION`                                          AS `ORGANIZATION`,
  `ORGANIZATION_NAME`                                     AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
  `DLC_KEY`                                               AS `DLC_KEY`,
  `DLC_NAME`                                              AS `DLC_NAME`
FROM (
  -- base rows come from fac_rooms_space_area to ensure one row per organization_key (grain)
  -- carry through keys so the view stays joinable; numeric-ish columns remain as text
  SELECT
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    -- ORGANIZATION_NUMBER: prefer explicit ORGANIZATION_KEY-derived short id if present,
    -- otherwise fall back to NULL (leave explicit NULLs as-is)
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`                                    AS `ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`,
    -- ORGANIZATION: short code if available, otherwise keep ORGANIZATION_KEY
    fr.`MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY`                              AS `ORGANIZATION`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`                                   AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    -- DLC (Division/Library/College) keys and names are not present in fac_rooms_space_area;
    -- keep as NULL so consumers can left-join to enrichment tables if needed.
    NULL                                                     AS `DLC_KEY`,
    NULL                                                     AS `DLC_NAME`
  FROM `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
  -- Deduplicate to one row per ORGANIZATION_KEY by taking first seen row per key.
  -- Use aggregated subselect to preserve textual columns without casting/aggregation semantics.
  GROUP BY fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`
) t

math_subjects_in_term.name: math_subjects_in_term
math_subjects_in_term.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sma.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  so.SUBJECT_ID,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- TOTAL_UNITS: prefer subject_summary enrollment agg if it has credit, else use subject_offered_latest_by_section TOTAL_UNITS-like column (not present) so fallback to NULL
  sse.total_subject_enrollment_credit AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  at.TERM_START_DATE,
  at.IS_REGULAR_TERM
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS so
  -- join to academic_terms to get term metadata; use academic_terms_all if academic_terms missing for some rows
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all AS sma ON sma.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE AND at.TERM_CODE IS NULL
  -- join to subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject to fetch department and enrollment credit (total units proxy)
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
    ON sse.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE AND sse.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE
  -- filter to Mathematics subjects: match department code/name or subject id starting with '18' or subject title contains 'Math'/'Mathematics'
  (
    (so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%' OR so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LIKE '%Math%'))
    OR (sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%' OR sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Math%'))
    OR (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND (so.SUBJECT_ID LIKE '18%' OR so.SUBJECT_ID LIKE 'MATH%'))
    OR (so.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND (so.SUBJECT_TITLE LIKE '%Mathematics%' OR so.SUBJECT_TITLE LIKE '%Math%'))
  )
math_subjects_in_term.description: Denormalized row-level view of subject offerings joined to their term and department information, exposing subject identifiers, title, total units, term code and academic year. Designed to expose Mathematics subjects per offering/term so downstream aggregations (min/max/variance) can be computed.

subject_offering_enrollment_rows.name: subject_offering_enrollment_rows
subject_offering_enrollment_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- Primary key for the row: carry through the summary key from the source view
  sols.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY                                      AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,

  -- Term and subject identifiers
  sol.TERM_CODE                                                          AS TERM_CODE,
  sol.SUBJECT_ID                                                         AS SUBJECT_ID,

  -- Raw subject title as provided in source (expose for distinct-title counting)
  sol.SUBJECT_TITLE                                                      AS SUBJECT_TITLE,

  -- Raw enrollment number at the subject-offered / summary row level.
  -- Prefer the subject-level enrollment if present; fall back to aggregated summary count.
  COALESCE(sols.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, sse.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,

  -- Canonical offering department code/name: prefer the offering dept on the section-level latest row,
  -- else fall back to the department from the subject-summary enrollment aggregation.
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE)                    AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME)                    AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,

  -- Canonical school attribution: prefer the offer school name from latest-by-section, else the
  -- school name from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject.
  COALESCE(sols.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sse.SCHOOL_NAME)                      AS SCHOOL_NAME

FROM
  -- Use the latest-by-section view as the primary source of per-section/summary rows.
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS sol

  -- The summary-level aggregation view contains canonical department/school and totals per term+subject.
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
    ON sol.TERM_CODE = sse.TERM_CODE
   AND sol.SUBJECT_ID = sse.SUBJECT_ID

  -- For clarity / joinability we expose a separate alias that represents the chosen "summary" row.
  -- Some pipelines keep a SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY on the latest-by-section view; carry it through if present.
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_latest_by_section AS sols
    ON sol.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sols.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
WHERE
  -- Filter to rows that represent a summary/section offering. Lift any literal selection out of the view;
  -- here we keep all rows and let consumers filter as needed.
  1 = 1
subject_offering_enrollment_rows.description: One row per subject offering (term + subject + section/summary) with raw subject title and enrollment number, normalized numeric enrollment and canonical department and school attribution. Exposes the row-level facts needed to count distinct subject titles and sum enrolled students.

department_degree_granting_list.name: department_degree_granting_list
department_degree_granting_list.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical department code (grain)
  sod.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- prefer a normalized department name from subject_summary if present, else fall back to offer dept name from latest sections
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(sod.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), '')
  ) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- school name: prefer subject_summary school then offer school
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(sse.SCHOOL_NAME), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(sod.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), '')
  ) AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- canonical boolean-ish normalization for "degree-granting"
  -- interpret common truthy textual values; lift specific literals out of view by using comparisons to normalized set
  CASE
    WHEN sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(sse.SCHOOL_NAME)) IN ('', 'n/a') THEN 'NO'  -- defensive: treat blank/n/a as NO
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME)) LIKE '%no degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME)) LIKE '%non-degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sod.OFFER_DEPT_NAME)) LIKE '%non-degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sod.OFFER_DEPT_NAME)) LIKE '%no degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sse.SCHOOL_NAME)) LIKE '%non-degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sse.SCHOOL_NAME)) LIKE '%no degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sod.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME)) LIKE '%non-degree%' THEN 'NO'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sod.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME)) LIKE '%no degree%' THEN 'NO'
    -- explicit common truthy indicators from aggregated enrollment/source flags (if present)
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME)) IN ('y','yes','true','t','1','degree granting','degree-granting') THEN 'YES'
    WHEN LOWER(TRIM(sod.OFFER_DEPT_NAME)) IN ('y','yes','true','t','1','degree granting','degree-granting') THEN 'YES'
    -- fallback: if we have any enrollment rows for this department, treat as degree-granting
    WHEN COALESCE(sse.total_subject_enrollment_number, 0) > 0 THEN 'YES'
    -- default to NO when ambiguous or explicitly excluded
    ELSE 'NO'
  END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING

FROM
  -- use the subject_offered_latest_by_section (sod) as the driving list of subjects/offering departments
  (SELECT DISTINCT
     SUBJECT_ID,
     OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
     OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
     OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
     MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
   FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
  ) AS sod

  -- left join to aggregated subject summary which carries canonical department/school names and enrollment counts
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
    ON sse.SUBJECT_ID = sod.SUBJECT_ID

-- ensure one row per department code by grouping and selecting representative values
GROUP BY
  sod.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- also group by the chosen department name and school name expressions to keep deterministic output
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(sod.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), '')),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sse.SCHOOL_NAME), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(sod.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), ''))
department_degree_granting_list.description: Canonical list of departments with degree-granting flag normalized to common truthy values and school membership. One row per SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE. Use this to filter/attribute subjects to degree-granting departments and to exclude specific departments.

dept_subjects_enrollment_agg.name: dept_subjects_enrollment_agg
dept_subjects_enrollment_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sa.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- count distinct subject titles only for subjects with enrollment > 0
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.total_subject_enrollment_number > 0 THEN sa.SUBJECT_TITLE END) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES,
  -- sum subject enrollment numbers but only for subjects with enrollment > 0
  SUM(CASE WHEN sa.total_subject_enrollment_number > 0 THEN COALESCE(sa.total_subject_enrollment_number,0) ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sa
-- group at department level (grain: one row per DEPARTMENT_CODE)
GROUP BY
  sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sa.SCHOOL_NAME
dept_subjects_enrollment_agg.description: Aggregated measures per department (DEPARTMENT_CODE) and school: distinct count of SUBJECT_TITLE (only subjects with enrollment >0) and sum of SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER across those subject offering rows. Grain is department code so this aggregation is reusable for per-department reporting and further school-level aggregation.

iap_activity_rows.name: iap_activity_rows

catalog_subject_by_subject_id.name: catalog_subject_by_subject_id
catalog_subject_by_subject_id.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- identifiers (grain: one row per MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE)
  COALESCE(cis.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, coso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`) AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
  COALESCE(cis.`SUBJECT_ID`, coso.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  COALESCE(cis.`SUBJECT_CODE`, coso.`SUBJECT_CODE`) AS `SUBJECT_CODE`,

  -- descriptive fields
  COALESCE(cis.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`, coso.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`) AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
  COALESCE(cis.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, coso.`SUBJECT_TITLE`) AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  COALESCE(cis.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`, coso.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`) AS `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,

  -- department / unit measures
  COALESCE(cis.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, coso.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(cis.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, coso.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(cis.`LECTURE_UNITS`, coso.`LECTURE_UNITS`) AS `LECTURE_UNITS`,
  COALESCE(cis.`TOTAL_UNITS`, coso.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`,

  -- term/year context - lifted literals should be provided by caller if needed;
  -- here we expose whichever effective/academic values exist on source rows
  COALESCE(cis.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, coso.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`) AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  COALESCE(cis.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`, coso.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`) AS `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`,

  -- preserve source provenance for joins / debugging
  cis.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `CIS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`,
  coso.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `COURSE_OFFERED_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  -- primary catalog metadata (cis_course_catalog) — may contain most canonical subject fields
  `cis_course_catalog` cis

  -- right-join course_catalog_subject_offered to bring in any subjects present only in offering tables
  LEFT JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered` coso
    ON cis.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = coso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
    AND cis.`SUBJECT_ID` = coso.`SUBJECT_ID`
    AND cis.`SUBJECT_CODE` = coso.`SUBJECT_CODE`

-- Note:
-- - This SELECT is intentionally simple: it exposes catalog subject metadata and measures per subject.
-- - Caller should filter by TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, or other literals outside the view.
catalog_subject_by_subject_id.description: Catalog subject metadata and measures per course catalog subject (cis_course_catalog / course_catalog_subject_offered / subject_summary style columns). Exposes subject identifiers, department and lecture units to join with offerings or IAP activities.

term_master_130.name: term_master_130
term_master_130.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.`TERM_CODE`                                                    AS TERM_CODE,
  -- keep original string dates as provided in source tables
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_START_DATE`, ata.`TERM_START_DATE`, atp.`TERM_START_DATE`) AS TERM_START_DATE,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_END_DATE`, ata.`TERM_END_DATE`, atp.`TERM_END_DATE`)       AS TERM_END_DATE,
  -- canonical current-term flag (prefer normalized field then fall back)
  COALESCE(at.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`, ata.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`, atp.`IS_CURRENT_TERM`) AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  -- status indicator (present on academic_terms)
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`, ata.`TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR`)        AS TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR,
  -- academic year fields
  COALESCE(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`)                      AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COALESCE(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`, ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`)            AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  -- description and selector
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, atp.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_SELECTOR`, ata.`TERM_SELECTOR`, atp.`TERM_INDICATOR`) AS TERM_SELECTOR
FROM
  -- prefer the primary academic_terms table for canonical values
  academic_terms at
  -- bring in any archival/all record to fill nulls
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all ata
    ON ata.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
  -- bring in parameter table (may have TERM_INDICATOR or slightly different naming)
  LEFT JOIN academic_term_parameter atp
    ON atp.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
GROUP BY
  at.`TERM_CODE`,
  TERM_START_DATE,
  TERM_END_DATE,
  IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR,
  ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  TERM_SELECTOR
term_master_130.description: Canonical term-level records with key term identifiers and status/flags used for filtering (current term flag, status indicator, term start/end, academic year and description). One row per term_code.

hr_org_units_with_numeric_dept_code_old.name: hr_org_units_with_numeric_dept_code_old
hr_org_units_with_numeric_dept_code_old.body_sql:
SELECT
  ho.`HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY`,
  ho.`HR_ORG_UNIT_ID`,
  ho.`HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE`,
  -- cast the existing HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD to numeric (NULL if not numeric)
  CASE
    WHEN ho.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
      THEN CAST(ho.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` AS DECIMAL(18,6))
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD_numeric`,
  ho.`HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  ho.`DLC_KEY`
FROM `hr_org_unit` ho
WHERE
  -- keep only rows where HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD looks like a number
  ho.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` IS NOT NULL
  AND ho.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` <> ''
  AND ho.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
hr_org_units_with_numeric_dept_code_old.description: One row per HR organization unit (hr_org_unit) that has a numeric HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD value; cast HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD to numeric and expose identifying columns for joining to facility organizations.

fac_organizations_canonical.name: fac_organizations_canonical
fac_organizations_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical stable key for organization (carry through joinable key)
  frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,

  -- organization id: prefer ORGANIZATION_KEY-derived id if available, else normalized ORGANIZATION_NAME shortened to 100 chars
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`, ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`), '')
  ) AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`,

  -- canonical organization name (trimmed); keep original case but strip surrounding whitespace
  NULLIF(TRIM(frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`), '') AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,

  -- DLC_KEY: some integrations use DLC_KEY; if present on fac_rooms_space_area propagate, else NULL
  frs.`MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `DLC_KEY`

FROM
  -- source of facility organization assignments per room; one row per FAC_ROOM -> provides ORGANIZATION_KEY and ORGANIZATION_NAME
  `fac_rooms_space_area` frs

-- Only keep real organization rows (have an ORGANIZATION_KEY or name)
WHERE
  (frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND frs.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` <> '')
  OR (frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(frs.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`) <> '')
fac_organizations_canonical.description: Canonical list of facility organizations (fac_organization) with their stable id and name, exposing keys used to join to HR org units (DLC_KEY / ORGANIZATION_KEY / ORGANIZATION_ID / ORGANIZATION_NAME). Also normalizes ORGANIZATION_ID and ORGANIZATION_NAME for filtering.

space_detail_room_level.name: space_detail_room_level
space_detail_room_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY                                   AS BUILDING_KEY,           -- carry a key to joinable building/room
  fr.ROOM                                           AS BUILDING_ROOM,          -- room identifier within building
  fr.SPACE_ID                                       AS SPACE_UNIT_KEY,         -- physical space unit key (room-level)
  fr.USE_KEY                                        AS SPACE_USAGE_KEY,        -- usage classification key for the space
  fr.AREA                                           AS ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,    -- measured square footage for the room
  fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE                            AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE     -- load date for freshness
FROM
  fac_rooms_space_area fr
WHERE
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.ROOM IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.SPACE_ID IS NOT NULL
space_detail_room_level.description: One row per physical room measurement (room-level record) with room identifiers and square footage, suitable as the base cohort for analyses by building, building_room, and space usage key.

space_usage_lookup.name: space_usage_lookup
space_usage_lookup.body_sql:

  `USE_KEY`                 AS `SPACE_USAGE_KEY`,
  `USE_DESC`                AS `SPACE_USAGE`,

room_squarefootage_variance_by_room_and_.name: room_squarefootage_variance_by_room_and_usage
room_squarefootage_variance_by_room_and_.body_sql:
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `ROOM` AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  `USE_KEY` AS `SPACE_USAGE_KEY`,
  COUNT(*) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
