  `fac_rooms_space_area`
WHERE
  `AREA` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `ROOM`,
  `USE_KEY`
room_squarefootage_variance_by_room_and_.description: Per BUILDING_ROOM and SPACE_USAGE_KEY, compute variance of ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE across the rows (room-level measurements). Intended to be aggregated further (e.g. max variance per SPACE_USAGE).

subject_summary_cohort.name: subject_summary_cohort
subject_summary_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  ss.TERM_CODE,
  ss.SUBJECT_ID,
  COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ss.TOTAL_UNITS,
  ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
FROM
  subject_summary ss
LEFT JOIN
  subject_offered_latest_by_section so
  ON ss.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY = so.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY
WHERE
  -- keep only offerings with positive units and at least one enrollee
  COALESCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) > 0
  AND COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) > 0
subject_summary_cohort.description: One-row-per-subject-offering rows from subject_summary restricted to subject offerings with positive TOTAL_UNITS and at least one enrollee; exposes department and unit/enrollment columns for downstream aggregation and filtering.

overall_total_units_avg.name: overall_total_units_avg
overall_total_units_avg.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- overall average of TOTAL_UNITS across subject-level cohort
  AVG(ss.total_subject_enrollment_credit) AS OVERALL_AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COUNT(*) AS OVERALL_SUBJECT_COUNT
FROM
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
grain: /* no key column; this view is an aggregate at the dataset-level */
overall_total_units_avg.description: Single-row aggregation (overall average TOTAL_UNITS across the same subject-level cohort). Intended to be joined into department-level rows to compare department averages vs overall average. The view itself remains general (overall average for the filtered cohort).

department_degree_flag.name: department_degree_flag
department_degree_flag.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- keep department code as primary key for the view grain
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- prefer a cleaned department name from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject if available,
  -- otherwise fall back to any name present in other sources (here ds)
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ss.DEPT_NAME_ALT, '')) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- school affiliation: prefer enrollment aggregate school_name, else offer_school from latest section view, else null
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(sol.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, '')) AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- boolean-ish flag indicating whether department awards degrees.
  -- Heuristic: if subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject has any rows for this department (i.e. aggregated data exists),
  -- treat as degree-granting (common pattern). Also allow override if a department appears in fac rooms space area (physical dept),
  -- but primary driver is enrollment aggregation.
  CASE
    WHEN ss.SUBJECT_COUNT_IS_NONZERO = 1 THEN 'Y'
    WHEN sol.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    WHEN fra.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
FROM
  (
    -- derive distinct department codes from enrollment summary (preferred source)
    SELECT
      DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      MAX(DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
  ) ds

  -- left join the enrollment aggregate to pull school name and existence indicator
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      MAX(SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
      -- also bring an alternate dept name (if different) for fallback
      MAX(DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME_ALT,
      -- indicator whether there is at least one subject aggregated (nonzero row)
      1 AS SUBJECT_COUNT_IS_NONZERO
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
  ) ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  -- left join latest-by-section view to get an offering-level school/dept signals (may capture departments not in enrollment agg)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
      MAX(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
      MAX(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> ''
    GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  ) sol ON sol.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  -- left join physical space table to include departments that exist as organizations in facility data
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_CODE FROM fac_rooms_space_area WHERE DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPT_CODE <> ''
  ) fra ON fra.DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
department_degree_flag.description: Normalized department-level attributes (one row per department code) including degree-granting flag and school affiliation to support department-level filtering and joins.

subject_offering_term_level.name: subject_offering_term_level
subject_offering_term_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`                       AS SUBJECT_KEY,
  so.`TERM_CODE`                                 AS TERM_CODE,
  so.`SUBJECT_ID`                                AS SUBJECT_ID,
  so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`                         AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  so.`COURSE_NUMBER`                             AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  so.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`                           AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  so.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`                           AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`                         AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- prefer section-level subject enrollment when present, else aggregated subject enrollment
  COALESCE(so.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, ssea.`total_subject_enrollment_number`) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  -- canonical numeric count of enrolled students from the latest-by-section view
  so.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`                     AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  so.`IS_OSE_SUBJECT`                            AS IS_OSE_SUBJECT,
  so.`IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT`                     AS IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
  -- take warehouse load date from the subject-offered source (falls back to subject-summary agg last load)
  COALESCE(so.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, ssea.`last_warehouse_load_date`) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section so
LEFT JOIN
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ssea
    ON so.`TERM_CODE` = ssea.`TERM_CODE`
   AND so.`SUBJECT_ID` = ssea.`SUBJECT_ID`
/* Lifted literals:
   - none (this view is parameter-free; filtering by TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
     SCHOOL_NAME, or graduate/undergraduate should be done by consumers using these columns) */
subject_offering_term_level.description: One row per course offering (section/subject) in a specific term. Exposes subject identifiers, term, department and school, enrollment counts, level/graduate indicators, and related catalog keys to support filtering by year/term, department, school, and graduate/undergraduate status.

students_directory_core.name: students_directory_core
students_directory_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary identifier: full name for one-row-per-student grain
  COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME, CONCAT_WS(' ',
    ed.PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, ed.PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, ed.PREFERRED_LAST_NAME)
  ) AS FULL_NAME,

  -- contact email (lifted as-is; literal values for selection should be provided outside the view)
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,

  -- primary department (department name is preferred, fall back to department number)
  COALESCE(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) AS DEPARTMENT,

  -- student year: attempt to map from directory title or primary title if available.
  -- Keep as free-text so calling queries can map to standardized buckets outside the view.
  COALESCE(ed.DIRECTORY_TITLE, ed.PRIMARY_TITLE) AS STUDENT_YEAR,

  -- carry through key for joinability (not in required output columns but useful to downstream joins)
  ed.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID
FROM
  employee_directory ed
WHERE
  -- restrict to records that look like students rather than staff.
  -- This predicate is intentionally permissive; concrete filtering rules (e.g., by EMPLOYEE_TYPE)
  -- should be supplied by caller as view consumers know selection literals.
  (ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL OR ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL)
students_directory_core.description: Row-level student directory records (one row per student) with identifying and contact fields and their primary department and student year.

subject_offered_enrollments_fallback.name: subject_offered_enrollments_fallback
subject_offered_enrollments_fallback.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  so.TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_ID,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- prefer OFFER_DEPT_CODE from subject_offered; fallback NULL (lifted literal should be provided at query-time if needed)
  so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  -- SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER comes from subject_offered if present; else use subject_summary aggregate total_subject_enrollment_number
  COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ss.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  -- NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS: prefer section-level NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS from subject_offered, else use aggregate total_subject_enrollment_number
  COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section so
LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
  ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  AND so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID

semantic_filters.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER: IS NOT NULL OR NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL

subject_offered_enrollments_fallback.description: One row per offered subject section containing enrollment counts and offer-department code. This is a fallback source when subject_summary lacks department codes or enrollments. Exposes subject_offered keys and NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER fields.

subject_summary_academic_year_dept_units.name: subject_summary_academic_year_dept_units
subject_summary_academic_year_dept_units.body_sql:
SELECT
  sse.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  sse.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sse.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `NUM_SUBJECTS`,
  COALESCE(SUM(sse.`TOTAL_UNITS`),0) AS `TOTAL_UNITS_SUM`,
  -- keep raw count of subject-level TOTAL_UNITS observations for downstream variance/stddev calc
  SUM(CASE WHEN sse.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS `TOTAL_UNITS_COUNT`,
  -- average units per subject (uses SUM/COUNT to remain consistent with stored SUM and COUNT)
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sse.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0
       THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(sse.`TOTAL_UNITS`) / SUM(CASE WHEN sse.`TOTAL_UNITS` IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
  END AS `TOTAL_UNITS_AVG`
FROM (
  /* build the current-term subject cohort: use subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
     which contains subject-level enrollment and (we assume) subject TOTAL_UNITS in a column named TOTAL_UNITS.
     The schema provided for that view does not list TOTAL_UNITS explicitly; to keep this view reusable,
     expect the calling code to provide TOTAL_UNITS in that source. If TOTAL_UNITS column name differs,
     lift that literal out of the view as instructed. */
  SELECT
    t.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    t.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    s.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    s.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    -- assume TOTAL_UNITS is provided per subject row in source; pass through as-is
    -- if TOTAL_UNITS is not present in the source, upstream ETL should supply it
    s.`total_subject_enrollment_credit` AS `TOTAL_UNITS`
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject s
  JOIN academic_terms t
    ON s.`TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE`
  WHERE t.`IS_CURRENT_TERM` = 'Y'
) sse
GROUP BY
  sse.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  sse.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`
subject_summary_academic_year_dept_units.description: Aggregated measures per academic year and department: raw sum of TOTAL_UNITS and count of subjects, built from the current-term subject cohort. Keeps one row per academic year + department to support variance/stddev computation at those group levels. Does NOT compute variance/stddev itself (keeps raw per-subject TOTAL_UNITS via count and sum for reuse).

library_reserve_materials_by_subject_ter.name: library_reserve_materials_by_subject_term
library_reserve_materials_by_subject_ter.body_sql:
SELECT
  lrd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
  lrd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
  lrd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
  lrd.`TERM_CODE`,
  lrd.`SUBJECT_ID`,
  lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS`
FROM
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail` AS lrd
  LEFT JOIN `library_material_status` AS lms
    ON lrd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
library_reserve_materials_by_subject_ter.description: One row per library reserve material association linking subjects offered in a term to the reserve material and its status. Exposes the reserve STATUS code to allow filtering by status 'U' and the linking keys to subject records.

subject_summary_per_subject.name: subject_summary_per_subject
subject_summary_per_subject.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary key for the subject summary row: prefer existing SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY from latest-by-section if available,
  -- otherwise synthesize by concatenating TERM_CODE and SUBJECT_ID to preserve joinability downstream.
  COALESCE(sobs.`SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
           CONCAT(sset.`TERM_CODE`, '||', sset.`SUBJECT_ID`)) AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,

  -- term and subject identifiers
  COALESCE(sobs.`TERM_CODE`, sset.`TERM_CODE`) AS `TERM_CODE`,
  COALESCE(sobs.`SUBJECT_ID`, sset.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `SUBJECT_ID`,

  -- canonical subject title: prefer the more specific latest-by-section title, otherwise the aggregated title
  COALESCE(sobs.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, sset.`SUBJECT_TITLE`) AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,

  -- offering department code and human-readable names: prefer offering dept from latest section,
  -- fall back to department_code/name from the enrollment aggregation
  COALESCE(sobs.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`, sset.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
  COALESCE(sobs.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, sset.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  COALESCE(sobs.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`, sset.`SCHOOL_NAME`) AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,

  -- raw numeric enrollment measure: prefer the subject_enrollment_number from latest-by-section (most granular),
  -- otherwise use the aggregated total_subject_enrollment_number from the enrollment aggregate
  COALESCE(sobs.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, sset.`total_subject_enrollment_number`) AS `SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`

FROM
  -- aggregated enrollment and canonical department linkage per term+subject
  `subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject` AS sset

  -- left join to the latest-by-section view to bring canonical offer-dept and per-subject counts where present
  LEFT JOIN `subject_offered_latest_by_section` AS sobs
    ON sobs.`TERM_CODE` = sset.`TERM_CODE`
   AND sobs.`SUBJECT_ID` = sset.`SUBJECT_ID`

-- Note: This SELECT defines one row per subject summary using the enrollment-agg table as the driving table.
-- It carries through SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY when available from the latest-by-section view to preserve joinability.
subject_summary_per_subject.description: One row per subject-offering (subject summary row) exposing enrollment counts and department linkage; keeps raw numeric enrollment measures and canonical department identifiers for downstream grouping/filters.

sis_department_meta.name: sis_department_meta
sis_department_meta.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical department code (use DEPARTMENT_CODE from subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject as primary source)
  COALESCE(sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, fr.DEPT_CODE, ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

  -- short name / display name for department (prefer subject-summary name, then fac_rooms, then employee directory)
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

  -- fuller descriptive name: prefer subject title (if available) else department name; keep same as DEPARTMENT_NAME when nothing else
  COALESCE(NULLIF(sse.SUBJECT_TITLE, ''), NULLIF(sse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), NULLIF(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')) AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,

  -- school code and name from subject summary (authoritative for academic mapping)
  sse.SCHOOL_CODE AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  sse.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,

  -- degree-granting flag: infer from presence in subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject (has subjects => degree-granting = 'Y'), else default 'N'
  CASE WHEN sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING

FROM
  -- start from distinct departments observed in subject summary (authoritative academic mapping)
  (
    SELECT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      SUBJECT_TITLE,
      SCHOOL_CODE,
      SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME
  ) sse

-- left join to fac_rooms_space_area to pick up department names / org names when subject summary lacks them
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area fr
  ON fr.DEPT_CODE = sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE

-- left join to employee directory for department metadata fallback
LEFT JOIN employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
  ON ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = sse.DEPARTMENT_CODE
sis_department_meta.description: Department metadata rows with canonical department codes, full names, school name and degree-granting flag; used to filter departments and to join department attributes into analyses.

department_subject_enrollment_agg.name: department_subject_enrollment_agg
department_subject_enrollment_agg.body_sql:
SELECT
  ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  AVG(ss.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS AVG_NUM_ENROLLED,
  VARIANCE(ss.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS VAR_NUM_ENROLLED,
  STDDEV(ss.total_subject_enrollment_number) AS STDDEV_NUM_ENROLLED
FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
WHERE ss.total_subject_enrollment_number IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE
department_subject_enrollment_agg.description: Aggregated enrollment statistics per department (department code) computed from subject_summary rows: raw count of distinct subjects, average, variance, and sample standard deviation of SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER. This view groups at the department level to provide the measures commonly required for department-level reporting. NULL enrollment values are ignored in these aggregations.

space_detail_floor_room_rows.name: space_detail_floor_room_rows
space_detail_floor_room_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`,
  fr.`ROOM` AS `BUILDING_ROOM`,
  fr.`AREA` AS `ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  fr.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM
  fac_rooms_space_area fr
space_detail_floor_room_rows.description: Row-level cohort of space_detail rows (one row per space unit/room) exposing building, floor, room, square footage and warehouse load date for filtering and downstream aggregation.

space_floor_aggregates.name: space_floor_aggregates
space_floor_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR` AS `FLOOR`,
  MAX(fr.`AREA`) AS `MAX_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  -- pick any FAC_ROOM_KEY that attains the max AREA on that floor
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(
    GROUP_CONCAT(fr.`FAC_ROOM_KEY` ORDER BY fr.`AREA` DESC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1
  ) AS `BUILDING_ROOM_WITH_MAX_SQFT`,
  COUNT(*) AS `ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR`
FROM
  `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
-- Note: input filters should be applied by selecting from this view (lifted out of the view per instructions).
GROUP BY
  fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  fr.`FLOOR`
space_floor_aggregates.description: Per-floor aggregates for rooms within a building: maximum ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE on the floor and count of rooms meeting the input filters. Keeps link to one BUILDING_ROOM that attains the maximum via selecting any matching BUILDING_ROOM (non-deterministic if ties).
